Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At ING we are looking for a Data Analyst




Your role and work environment:




We are looking for a passionate, high-energy Data Analyst to join our Data Consumption and Culture Team of Data & AI Tribe




Our mission is to unlock business value from data by driving adoption, understanding, governance, and effective consumption of trusted data products. We work side by side with business stakeholders, data product teams, and technology teams to ensure that analytics and reporting are:




- Trusted and governed

- Easy to understand and use

- Focused on real impact and decision-making




We operate in a collaborative, business-oriented and data-driven environment, where curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement are part of our DNA.




We are building a team of data partners who help the business make better decisions.

Your key responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst you will:




- Design, build and evolve impactful dashboards and reporting solutions using tools like Power BI and MicroStrategy

- Go beyond reporting: analyze data to generate insights that influence business decisions

- Ensure high standards of data quality, consistency and governance across reporting assets

- Partner with stakeholders to define, challenge and refine KPIs and metrics Translate business needs into clear, scalable and reusable reporting solutions

- Create and maintain functional and technical documentation

- Actively contribute to data adoption and data literacy initiatives across the organization

What are we looking for?




We are looking for someone with drive, curiosity and a strong sense of ownership. If you enjoy working close to the business and turning data into real impact, this role is for you.




Key skills and experience:

- Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI, MicroStrategy or similar)

- Strong SQL and data analysis skills

- Ability to communicate complex ideas in a simple way, to both technical and non-technical audiences

- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

- Passion for continuous improvement and learning




What do we offer?

The time you spend at work, the challenges you face or the lessons you get are very important, but… What about your personal life? At ING we want your work to fulfill you in every way, and that is why we take care of even the smallest details.




Check out what is waiting for you!




Balance That Works.

We put balance to work, so you can do it too. With our customers’ needs first, the team´s and your own, we agree when to come to ING MAD and when to work best from home. More time together when it matters, more freedom when you need it.

Restaurant card.

So that thinking about what to have for lunch doesn’t take up your time or your cravings.




Our house will be your home.

In our offices you can find electric mobility solutions, doctor, hairdresser, gym, The Good Service (to help you with your errands) and much more!




Health insurance.

For you and all your family (spouse/partner and children).




Life insurance.

We help you protect what matters most to you.




Flexible remuneration.

In addition, you will enjoy our flexible remuneration model, through a more tax-advantaged way, you will be able to access other services such as nursery, transport card, training aids…




Free company shuttle.

It doesn't matter where you live. We have 6 routes (North, Central, South, A5, A42 and A6) to get you to our ING office in Madrid comfortably.




Banking benefits.

Special loans with more beneficial conditions.

Special mortgage conditions after 6 months working at the bank.

And you can benefit from our pension plan after 1 month with us!




More vitality and more belonging

360º care of the employee (physical, mental, social connection & purpose).

Physiotherapy service on site.

Clinics with professional, world-class athletes.

Gympass service.

Employee Networks: Rainbow Lions (LGBTQI+), Leonas & RIÑG.

International Remote work program.

Get to know Us




We are a team of more than 1800 people sharing one idea: doing our bit in helping our clients create a better future for themselves, by providing them with the tools they need to get where they want to go.




A fully online bank where technology, innovation, simplicity and transparency are the main ingredients, and the first one to work with agile methodologies.




And although we are based in Spain, we are lucky to work in an international bank with presence in more than 40 countries.




We are proud to have a diverse team, and we are committed to continue developing a culture of Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging to foster a culture of collaboration and innovation that represents all collectives in the society.




And even though we look orange on the outside, we are green on the inside. Our ambition in Sustainability is Empowering (y)our Sustainability journey. We are embarking on our path, for us, but we are also there for when our clients decide to embark on this journey.




Making things happen, helping others be successful, always being one step ahead—that’s our DNA. If you look at yourself in the mirror and your reflection matches our way of being and working…we are looking forward to meeting you!




At ING, you belong just as you are. We hire and support people for their talent and potential — and we know that when you can be yourself, you do your best work.




Job Application Safety Reminder




We’re seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

•Apply only via official ING platforms: ING uses Workday and LinkedIn as its internal recruitment system. Applications should be submitted only via our official career site or via ING job postings on LinkedIn.

•Check the sender’s email carefully: Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.

•No payments or banking details will ever be requested: If someone asks for this information, it’s a scam.

Title: Asset Management Data Analyst
Description:
At Taylor Hopkinson, we are currently recruiting an Asset Management Data Analyst for a company focused on the development and operation of utility-scale solar projects across Spain.




Role Overview

As an Asset Management Data Analyst, you will play a key role in monitoring and optimizing the performance of a portfolio of operating solar assets. You will analyze asset performance, support reporting activities and provide data-driven insights that contribute to operational excellence and long-term asset value.




Key Responsibilities

Monitor the operational performance of utility-scale solar assets, tracking technical and financial KPIs.
Analyze production data, availability and performance trends to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Support the preparation of operational, financial and ESG reports for the asset portfolio.
Review technical documentation, maintenance activities and contractual performance.
Assist in budget tracking and performance analysis, ensuring alignment between operational and financial data.
Collaborate with internal teams including Operations, Finance, Legal and Investment to support effective asset management.
Contribute to process improvements, KPI development and continuous performance optimization.




Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Finance or a related discipline.
Previous experience in renewable energy, asset management, data analytics or a similar analytical role.
Advanced Excel skills are essential; Power BI experience is highly desirable.
Professional proficiency in English.

Title: AI & Data Analyst
Description:
Qualitas Funds is looking to hire an AI & Data Analyst to accelerate the adoption of artificial intelligence and data across the firm, with a primary focus on the investment team.




Qualitas is a private equity manager specialised in the European lower mid-market, with investment strategies across primary funds, co-investments and secondaries. Over the past few years, we have developed a proprietary market intelligence platform, Qualitas Insight, as well as an extensive roadmap of AI initiatives aimed at improving the way we analyse funds, companies, markets and investment opportunities




We are looking for someone with an analytical mindset, strong execution capabilities and genuine curiosity for technology, who wants to combine artificial intelligence, data and investing in a demanding, entrepreneurial environment with high exposure to the senior team.




This is a unique time to join Qualitas Funds. Artificial intelligence and data are a strategic priority for the firm, and this position will play a central role in turning that potential into concrete tools that improve how we analyse opportunities, make decisions and scale our processes. We are looking for someone with the ambition to build, strong execution capabilities and a long-term mindset to grow alongside the project.




The Role:




The position will be integrated into the investment team and will work closely with different departments across the firm, as well as with internal developers and technology partn

ers.The main objective will be to convert already identified business needs into operational tools with real impact on Qualitas’ day-to-day activities. In the short term, the person will be responsible for coordinating and executing AI and data initiatives; over time, we expect the role to evolve into a central position in the continuous improvement of Qualitas’ investment processes.




Responsibilities:




Driving and coordinating artificial intelligence projects applied to the investment team and other areas of the firm.
Translating business needs into concrete solutions, working alongside the investment team, internal developers and technology partners.
Designing, developing and implementing agentic workflows, automations and tools based on generative AI.
Ensuring the effective adoption of existing AI agents and tools, monitoring usage, improvements and new needs.
Contributing to the evolution of Qualitas Insight, our proprietary market intelligence platform.
Performing data analysis on funds, companies, sectors, markets and investment opportuneities.
Participating in the preparation of investment recommendations, both for direct investment opportunities and primary fund investments.
Improving internal investment team processes by identifying opportunities for automation, efficiency and scalability.
Coordinating technology providers, developers and internal stakeholders to ensure execution, quality and timely delivery




Knowledge and Experience




2-3 years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, data & analytics, artificial intelligence, product, operations or technology project management.
Ability to understand business needs and translate them into concrete tools.
Familiarity with generative AI and automation tools.
Ability to develop or coordinate agentic workflows independently.
Basic knowledge of SQL and/or Python will be highlyvalued.
Knowledge of corporate finance, private equity or company analysis will be a plus, but is not required
Excellent analytical skills.
Strong organisation and project management capabilities.
Autonomy, proactivity and results orientation.
Strong execution discipline and rigorous follow-up.
Intellectual curiosity and comfort working on new, undefined problems.
Good communication skills with both business and technical profiles.
Ability to work from a blank sheet of paper and turn ideas into operational solutions.

Title: Data Analyst Junior
Description:
Descripción de la oferta

En nuestro Programa Talento Joven buscamos personas recién tituladas en Formación Profesional de informática, análisis de datos o programación, con interés en adquirir experiencia y conocimientos prácticos en el campo del Data Science.




Funciones:

Participar en un programa formativo de 30 semanas enfocado en habilidades técnicas y prácticas de análisis de datos.
Trabajar sobre proyectos reales y simulaciones del entorno empresarial, incluyendo retos de predicción, análisis exploratorio y visualización de datos.
Colaborar y aprender directamente de profesionales en activo que te acompañarán durante tu evolución.
Practicar con herramientas como Python, SQL, Pandas, Power BI, Jupyter Notebooks y Scikit-learn.
Aplicar procedimientos y buenas prácticas de análisis en entornos controlados de laboratorio.




Lo que ofrecemos:

Plan formativo diseñado y actualizado según las necesidades reales del mercado laboral en data.
Formación práctica, en grupo reducido, orientada al trabajo que se realiza en equipos de data science.
Mentoring personalizado con especialistas del sector.
Posibilidad real de entrevista para ofertas de empleo al finalizar el programa en empresas colaboradoras.
Red de contacto con profesionales y exalumnos del programa.




Requisitos:

Ciclo Formativo de Grado Medio o Superior relacionado con informática, análisis de datos o programación.
Interés por el análisis de datos y motivación para afrontar retos prácticos.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, comunicarte y aprender en un entorno técnico.




Tipo de puesto: Formativo/Prácticas

Ubicación: Modalidad híbrida (presencial y online) según disponibilidad.

Duración: 30 semanas.

Incorporación: Octubre 2026.

• Elaboración y mantenimiento de documentación técnica y funcional.

• Colaboración con equipos de negocio para automatizar procesos y mejorar la productividad.

• Análisis y tratamiento de datos para apoyar la toma de decisiones.

• Al menos 2 años de experiencia en automatización y optimización de procesos.

• Experiencia desarrollando automatizaciones y scripts con Python.

• Conocimientos de SQL para consultas y gestión de bases de datos.

• Experiencia en análisis de datos y tratamiento de información.

• Nivel de inglés alto.

• Experiencia con herramientas de análisis de datos y reporting.

• Capacidad para trabajar en entornos multidisciplinares y colaborar con áreas de negocio.

🎯 Lo que ofrecemos

Formar parte de SOTEC Consulting significa integrarte en una compañía con más de 30 años de experiencia en el sector IT, respaldada por la solidez del Grupo ASTEK.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists ‌work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Data Analyst to support regulatory reporting. You'll work with complex data structures, adapting them to strict specifications, and ensure solutions are efficient and reliable.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You'll Be Doing


Supporting the Finance team with financial planning, treasury operations, financial strategy, and regulatory reporting
Building and adapting data models and ETL processes for regulatory reporting
Maintaining and improving reporting infrastructure, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and high data quality
Translating complex requirements into clear, efficient data solutions
Understanding our business and its processes through our data
Monitoring and improving data reliability, applying high attention to detail
Designing key metrics to measure different aspects of the business
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Maintaining and creating dashboards to track metrics and visualise insights
Collaborating closely with Regulatory Reporting Managers to understand reporting logic and operational processes


What You'll Need


4+ years experience with SQL, and a solid understanding of complex data systems
Experience in an analytical role, creating impactful solutions
Great collaboration skills to partner with Regulatory Reporting Managers and cross-functional teams
A background or education in a quantitative discipline
To be detail-oriented, quality-focused, and able to deliver under time constraints
Proficiency with Python or other programming languages
The ability to adjust data to strict regulatory specifications
Solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
A proactive mindset with sense of urgency


Nice to have


Experience in finance, banking, and/or accounting
An advanced degree in a core STEM subject
Proficiency with additional programming languages, such as Java, Scala, or C++
To have participated in school/university Olympiad competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Title: Data Analyst & SIOP
Description:
Hayward is a leading global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of pool equipment and automation systems for the rapidly growing Outdoor Living market. We have a recognized brand, a large installed base of pool equipment, strong customer relationships, and a history of innovation with a focus on energy efficiency and sustainability.

Role Purpose

We are looking for a Supply Chain Data Analyst to support our SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) team in Getafe. This role will focus on analyzing ERP and supply chain data and developing Power BI dashboards to drive planning, inventory, and operational decisions, as well as actively supporting and facilitating the monthly SIOP cycle.

Key Responsibilities


Create and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports for SIOP and Supply Chain teams
Analyze data from ERP systems to support demand planning, inventory, and production planning
Track and report KPIs such as forecast accuracy, inventory levels, service level, and supply performance
Support and facilitate the monthly SIOP cycle, including preparing materials and leading data-driven review meetings
Identify risks, trends, and opportunities across the supply chain


Requirements


3+ years of experience in data analysis (within supply chain or operations is a plus)
Strong Power BI experience (DAX, data models, dashboards)
Understanding of supply chain processes (demand, inventory, production, logistics) is a plus.
Experience working with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Dynamics, or similar)


Advanced Excel Skills


Fluent in English
Comfortable presenting data and leading meetings in a cross-functional environment


Pay Range

48.000,00

Title: Analista de Auditoría Interna y Analítica de Datos
Description:
¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales?

En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti.

Buscamos incorporar un Analista de Auditoría Interna y Analítica de Datos al Departamento de Auditoría Interna de Deloitte España.

El Departamento de Auditoría Interna realiza funciones de seguimiento y mejora del sistema de control interno de calidad de Deloitte España. Reporta a la Comisión de Riesgos, Ética e Integridad del Consejo de Administración y al CEO, contribuyendo al fortalecimiento de la gestión de riesgos, el control interno y el buen gobierno de la Firma.

Buscamos profesionales con experiencia en auditoría que quieran complementar su perfil con capacidades de análisis de datos y nuevas tecnologías.

La posición ofrece una excelente oportunidad para desarrollar una carrera profesional en Auditoría Interna, Gestión de Riesgos y Analítica de Datos, participando en iniciativas de mejora continua mediante el uso de herramientas analíticas y nuevas tecnologías.

¿Cuál es el reto?


Participar en revisiones de auditoría interna y evaluación de controles.
Analizar riesgos, procesos e información de negocio.
Extraer, transformar y analizar datos mediante Excel, Power Query y Power BI.
Diseñar indicadores y cuadros de mando para el seguimiento de riesgos y recomendaciones.
Elaborar documentación e informes de auditoría.
Realizar seguimiento de planes de acción y medidas correctivas.
Utilizar nuevas herramientas tecnológicas como apoyo a los trabajos de auditoría.


¿Cómo te imaginamos?

Formación


Grado en Administración y Dirección de Empresas, Economía, Finanzas o similares con formación complementaria en Business Analytics, Big Data, Data Science o similares.
Se valorará formación complementaria en Business Analytics, Data Science o similares.


Experiencia


Entre 1 y 3 años de experiencia en Auditoría Interna, Auditoría Externa, Control Interno o Gestión de Riesgos.
Experiencia en revisión de procesos, evaluación de controles y elaboración de informes.


Conocimientos


Conocimiento de metodologías de auditoría y control interno.
Excel avanzado.
Experiencia en análisis de datos y Power BI.
Conocimientos de Power Query y DAX.
Se valorarán conocimientos de Python.
Se valorará experiencia o interés en herramientas como Microsoft Copilot o ChatGPT.


Competencias


Capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico.
Proactividad e iniciativa.
Curiosidad por la tecnología.
Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva.


¿Cómo es trabajar en Deloitte?

🤩 Proyectos de alto impacto donde tendrás un largo recorrido y aprendizaje

☯️ Un día a día híbrido-flexible: tendrás horario flexible y un buen equilibrio entre el teletrabajo y el trabajo en equipo en nuestras oficinas o las de nuestros clientes

⚽ Buen ambiente dentro y fuera de la oficina: disfrutarás de varios teambuildings al año, actividades culturales y deportivas… ¡y mucho más!

🧘‍♀️ Bienestar integral: cuídate con nuestro programa de salud física, mental y financiera… ¡y con equipo médico en las oficinas!

🤲 Impacto social: Podrás apuntarte a una gran cantidad de voluntariados de alcance nacional e internacional y a proyectos pro-bono con los que poner tu tiempo y talento al servicio de quienes más lo necesitan

🗣️Cultura del feedback y aprendizaje continuo: crecerás en un entorno inclusivo donde la igualdad de oportunidades y tu plan personalizado de formación impulsarán tu desarrollo. ¿Ya te visualizas en la Deloitte University de París?

Title: Data Engineer Analyst- 100% remote (Spain)
Description:
We are looking for the very Top Talent…and we would be delighted if you were to join our team!

More in details, UST is a multinational company based in North America, certified as a Top Employer and Great Place to Work company with over 35.000 employees all over the world and presence in more than 35 countries. We are leaders on digital technology services, and we provide large-scale technologic solutions to big companies.




What we look for?

We are looking for a Data Engineer Analyst with strong expertise in Market Risk, data transformation, and process parameterization. The ideal candidate has proven experience working with Mapper Engine, sensitivity mapping and transformations for VaR (Value at Risk) calculations, and is capable of working autonomously with a proactive mindset.

Key skills include advanced knowledge of PL/SQL, SQL, Control-M, and Market Risk frameworks such as sensitivities, VaR, and Stress Testing.




Main tasks and accountabilities will be:

Analyze, map, and transform market risk sensitivities for VaR calculation processes.

Manage and support the Mapper Engine process lifecycle.

Parameterize, maintain, and optimize processes using SQL and PL/SQL.

Configure, schedule, and monitor workflows using Control-M Workload Automation.

Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across risk management processes.

Collaborate with business and technical teams to implement data mapping and transformation requirements.

Support market risk reporting and risk calculation processes, including Stress Testing activities.

Analyze and resolve process incidents, performance issues, and data discrepancies.

Contribute to ETL and data integration initiatives related to risk management solutions.




What do we expect from you?

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst or similar role.

Proven experience in Market Risk, specifically:

Sensitivity mapping and transformation.

VaR (Value at Risk) calculations.

Stress Testing processes.

Advanced experience in PL/SQL (5–6 years preferred).

Advanced experience in Control-M Workload Automation (5–6 years preferred).

Advanced knowledge of AIRE, sensitivities, VaR, and Stress Test methodologies.

Strong expertise in SQL for process parameterization and optimization.

Experience with ETL, data mapping, and data transformation processes.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work independently, take initiative, and drive tasks to completion.

Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary environments.




Work Location

100% remote (Spain)




Work Schedule

Business hours.




What can we offer?

23 days of Annual Leave plus the 24th and 31st of December as discretionary days!

Numerous benefits (Health Care Plan, teleworking compensation, Life and Accident Insurances).

`Retribución Flexible´ Program: (Meals, Kinder Garden, Transport, online English lessons, Health Care Plan…)

Free access to several training platforms

Professional stability and career plans

UST also, compensates referrals from which you could benefit when you refer professionals.

Real Work Life Balance measures (flexibility, WFH or remote work policy, compacted hours during summertime…)




UST Club Platform discounts and gym Access discounts

Title: Técnico/a inteligencia comercial
Description:
Cuando te unes al equipo de CBNK, te conviertes en parte de la banca dedicada a los colectivos esenciales, un banco en el que nos dedicamos a comprender las necesidades específicas de los profesionales en campos como la ingeniería o la salud. Acompañamos a nuestros clientes a lo largo de todo su camino con un enfoque cercano y personalizado.




Nuestra misión es encontrar las soluciones financieras más adecuadas para impulsar negocios, fomentar sinergias y reforzar nuestro compromiso de ayudar a estos profesionales en su contribución al progreso de la sociedad.




En este rol de Técnico/a inteligencia comercial tendrás la oportunidad de generar un impacto significativo. Contarás con el apoyo necesario para tu formación y desarrollo profesional, mientras tus aportaciones serán valoradas y reconocidas. Colaboraremos en equipo para garantizar una experiencia excepcional al cliente, en un entorno donde se fomenta la escucha y el respeto de todas y cada una de las personas.




Tú papel es fundamental para generar inteligencia de negocio basada en datos internos y externos, con foco en la identificación de oportunidades comerciales, segmentación de clientes, performance de campañas y análisis de rentabilidad, apoyando la estrategia de crecimiento de la entidad. Analizar, estructurar y transformar datos comerciales en información accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones estratégicas y tácticas en la entidad.

Tu día a día será realizar las siguientes funciones:




Analizar datos de clientes, productos y canales para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y mejora en la eficiencia comercial.
Elaborar modelos de segmentación y scoring que faciliten una gestión comercial más precisa y personalizada.
Definir, generar y mantener dashboards de seguimiento comercial (KPI de ventas, campañas, productividad de red, etc.).
Gestionar acciones, campañas y seguimientos en Salesforce, generando y explorando informes dentro de la herramienta.
Realizar estudios ad-hoc para áreas de negocio (análisis de comportamiento, potenciales, fuga, rentabilidad por cliente, etc.).
Colaborar en la definición y evaluación de campañas comerciales, midiendo impactos y proponiendo ajustes.
Proporcionar soporte analítico a las áreas de marketing, productos y red comercial en la toma de decisiones.
Integrar datos de fuentes externas (INE, BDE, CNMV, geodemografía, etc.) para enriquecer los análisis y diagnósticos.
Asegurar la calidad y consistencia de los datos utilizados en el reporting comercial.
Mantener la caracterización de clientes




Requisitos:




Grado universitario Economía, Ingeniería o similar

3 años de experiencia en funciones de inteligencia comercial y, al menos 1 año en sector banca.

Conocimiento avanzado de Salesforce imprescindible.

Manejo avanzado de Excel y Power BI o herramientas similares de visualización.

Conocimientos sólidos en SQL y herramientas de explotación de datos.

Experiencia en manejo de bases de datos relacionales y diseño de consultas complejas.




Valorable:

Máster en Business Intelligence, Big Data, Data Science o Analítica de Negocio.




¡Descubre el equilibrio perfecto entre tu vida personal y profesional con nosotros!




Jornada de Verano: con un horario de 8:15 a 15:00 desde el 15 de junio al 15 de septiembre.

Retribución Flexible: Adapta tu salario a tus necesidades y preferencias personales.

Ventajas Financieras: Aprovecha todos los beneficios de ser empleado/a de nuestro banco.

35 días de vacaciones

Seguro Médico y de Vida

Title: Data Analyst, External Fulfillment EU
Place: San Fernando de Henares, Community of Madrid, Spain
Description:
Description

The EU External Fulfillment Ops Excellence team is looking for a hands-on, detail oriented and highly motivated Data Analyst to help create data backed insights. The data analyst will be responsible to analyze data to support support programs, dig deep into data to determine root cause of defects, build and maintain decision support tools, and present findings to business partners. In addition the Data Analyst will also be responsible for maintaining key metrics for business reviews.

Key job responsibilities


Assist in retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources to support decision-making processes
Help maintain and review KPIs on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis
Support the EU External Fulfillment Network with basic data requests
Contribute to data analysis that informs recommendations for EU EF Leadership
Participate in data mining and basic problem-solving tasks


A day in the life

This position is office-based.

Every day is different in this role. The work you’ll conduct is both proactive and reactive, requiring you to analyse the capacity per truck for the transportation network and work quickly to resolve any operational issues. You will find improvement opportunities and implement them in the network. If you’re looking to develop your career, you’ll be able to access development and mentorship opportunities to help you progress at Amazon.

Based at one of our sites, you'll be where the action is and work in an environment that encourages collaboration with a variety of internal and external stakeholders. By tapping into the latest performance indicators and metrics, you'll help us unlock our network's full potential.

Basic Qualifications


Experience in data analysis
Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel


Preferred Qualifications


Ability to work in a team environment
Problem solving experience
Ability to work independently
Experience with basic data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of Amazon systems and processes
Strong organizational skills
Interest in learning new technical tools
Basic understanding of data visualization concepts
Ability to maintain attention to detail
Good communication skills

Formarás parte del equipo de Business Intelligence, colaborando en el análisis de datos y el desarrollo de soluciones de reporting que faciliten la toma de decisiones estratégicas de la compañía.

Colaborar en la extracción, transformación y análisis de datos procedentes de diferentes sistemas.

Desarrollar consultas SQL para extraer, validar y transformar información.

Preparar informes y presentaciones para diferentes áreas de negocio.
Trabajar junto a los equipos de Operaciones, Producto y Desarrollo para comprender sus necesidades y convertirlas en soluciones de reporting.

Estar cursando el último año de estudios universitarios o haber finalizado recientemente un grado en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Datos, Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía o titulaciones afines.
Conocimientos intermedios o avanzados de SQL.
Manejo de alguna herramienta de visualización de datos como Domo, Tableau, QlikSense o Amazon QuickSight.
Capacidad analítica y facilidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de información.
Proactividad, organización y atención al detalle.

Haber realizado prácticas o proyectos relacionados con análisis de datos o Business Intelligence.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos.
Familiaridad con procesos ETL o integración de datos.
Conocimientos de Python o R.
Bases de estadística aplicada al análisis de datos.

Prácticas en nuestras oficinas de Madrid.
Formación y acompañamiento continuo por parte de un equipo especializado.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Vacancy: Data Analyst (Product Team)




About Us

Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Our technology powers an international community, delivering a world-class survey experience for members and high-quality insights for clients.

Our mission is simple yet powerful: to connect authentic members with market research surveys, enabling our clients to gain meaningful insights through online quantitative research. In return, members receive valuable rewards, ensuring genuine participation and engagement.




We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Product Team.




What You’ll Do

Own and enhance dashboards: Build and refine Metabase dashboards and reports to support key business stakeholders across product, operations, growth, and leadership.
Advanced SQL analysis: Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries to support critical reporting and decision-making.
Turn questions into insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into clear metrics, analyses, and recommendations (e.g., user behavior, funnel performance, retention, conversion, and revenue).
Define and monitor KPIs: Help define success metrics and maintain reliable reporting for core company KPIs across app and web experiences.
Data quality & instrumentation: Identify inconsistencies, missing data, or tracking gaps and propose scalable fixes in collaboration with engineering and analytics stakeholders.
Deep-dive analysis: Conduct ad hoc analysis, root-cause investigations, and opportunity sizing to guide prioritization and improve performance.
Enable self-serve analytics: Improve documentation, metric definitions, and dashboard usability so teams can confidently self-serve insights.




What We’re Looking For

2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics role in a data-driven organization (consumer apps, marketplaces, or subscription businesses are a plus).
Strong expertise in SQL (comfortable with complex queries, data modeling concepts, and performance tuning).
Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
Solid analytical foundations: Familiar with funnel analysis, cohorting/retention, segmentation, experimentation readouts, and KPI design.
Comfort with app + web analytics concepts (event tracking, attribution basics, behavioral analytics), and ability to learn new tools quickly.
Strong communication skills: Able to clearly explain findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Hands-on experience with MMPs: AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch.
A proactive, analytical mindset: You don’t just answer questions—you identify opportunities, risks, and what to measure next.




How to Apply

Use the Easy Apply button.

❗Important: We are not considering freelancers working on multiple projects simultaneously. This is a full-time position for a dedicated Data Analyst who is ready to commit to a single product ecosystem and contribute meaningfully to its long-term success.

Vacancy: Data Analyst (Product Team)


About Us

Prime Insights is a Sweden-based technology company reaching millions of diverse users through our proprietary Market Research Panel. Our technology powers an international community, delivering a world-class survey experience for members and high-quality insights for clients.

Our mission is simple yet powerful: to connect authentic members with market research surveys, enabling our clients to gain meaningful insights through online quantitative research. In return, members receive valuable rewards, ensuring genuine participation and engagement.


We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our Product Team.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and enhance dashboards: Build and refine Metabase dashboards and reports to support key business stakeholders across product, operations, growth, and leadership.
  • Advanced SQL analysis: Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries to support critical reporting and decision-making.
  • Turn questions into insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to translate business questions into clear metrics, analyses, and recommendations (e.g., user behavior, funnel performance, retention, conversion, and revenue).
  • Define and monitor KPIs: Help define success metrics and maintain reliable reporting for core company KPIs across app and web experiences.
  • Data quality & instrumentation: Identify inconsistencies, missing data, or tracking gaps and propose scalable fixes in collaboration with engineering and analytics stakeholders.
  • Deep-dive analysis: Conduct ad hoc analysis, root-cause investigations, and opportunity sizing to guide prioritization and improve performance.
  • Enable self-serve analytics: Improve documentation, metric definitions, and dashboard usability so teams can confidently self-serve insights.


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics role in a data-driven organization (consumer apps, marketplaces, or subscription businesses are a plus).
  • Strong expertise in SQL (comfortable with complex queries, data modeling concepts, and performance tuning).
  • Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Solid analytical foundations: Familiar with funnel analysis, cohorting/retention, segmentation, experimentation readouts, and KPI design.
  • Comfort with app + web analytics concepts (event tracking, attribution basics, behavioral analytics), and ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Strong communication skills: Able to clearly explain findings, assumptions, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with MMPs: AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch.
  • A proactive, analytical mindset: You don’t just answer questions—you identify opportunities, risks, and what to measure next.


How to Apply

Use the Easy Apply button.

  • ❗Important: We are not considering freelancers working on multiple projects simultaneously. This is a full-time position for a dedicated Data Analyst who is ready to commit to a single product ecosystem and contribute meaningfully to its long-term success.

Due diligence y valoración
Cierre de operaciones y reestructuración
Gestión amistosa de préstamos / gestión legal, real estate management, estrategia de comercialización y venta, reporting ; portfolio management
En el área de asset management, HipoGes gestiona una amplia gama de activos incluyendo hipotecas residenciales, préstamos a grandes corporaciones y PYMES, activos de real estate y préstamos sin garantía.



Descripción

El departamento de Marketing & Communication es el encargado de velar por la imagen de marca de la compañía (y marcas del grupo). Gestionar y desarrollar la comunicación externa e impulsar la comunicación interna. Dando soporte a todos los departamentos de la empresa.


Perfil

Descripción del puesto:

Buscamos un/a Analista Digital de Datos e Insights para el área de Marketing, con responsabilidad directa sobre la calidad, coherencia e interpretación del dato de marketing y comercial, y un papel clave como puente entre negocio y los equipos de Data/BI.

Su misión será asegurar que los datos sean fiables, comprensibles y accionables, transformándolos en análisis claros que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas y operativas del área de Marketing de la compañía, así como la elaboración de informes y reportes para dirección.

Funciones:

· Seguimiento diario de KPIs de negocio y marketing mediante herramientas de Business Intelligence.
· Ownership de la calidad del dato de marketing (definición, control y mejora continua).
· Detección de inconsistencias entre fuentes (CRM, BI, marketing, comercial) y coordinación para su corrección.
· Definición de KPIs claros, homogéneos y compartidos entre equipos.
· Traducción de datos complejos en insights accionables para perfiles no técnicos.
· Elaboración de recomendaciones basadas en datos.
· Identificación temprana de alertas y cambios de tendencia.
· Elaboración de informes de seguimiento y análisis.
· Diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
· Cruce, revisión y validación de datos procedentes de Marketing, Comercial y CRM.
· Colaboración continua con los equipos implicados para mejorar procesos y calidad del dato.

Requisitos:

Imprescindibles:
· Experiencia previa como Analista de Datos / BI / Reporting.
· Capacidad demostrada para interpretar datos.
· Perfil analítico, riguroso y ágil en el análisis.
· Buen manejo de Power BI.
· Conocimientos de SQL.
· Atlo nivel de Excel.
· SQL para exploración y validación de datos.

Valorable:
· Experiencia con datos de CRM.
· Experiencia previa en marketing, ventas, comercial.
· Experiencia colaborando con equipos de Data/Engineering.
· Experiencia en entornos con múltiples fuentes de datos.
· Experiencia en Real Estate, Finance en entornos digitales.

Title: Data Analyst / BI — Data Operations + BI
Description:
Sobre Balantia




En Balantia estamos reforzando nuestra Dirección del Dato y Tecnología para seguir impulsando una cultura basada en datos, decisiones informadas y procesos más eficientes. Buscamos una persona que quiera tener un rol clave en la evolución de nuestro ecosistema de datos, reporting y business intelligence.




Misión del puesto




Buscamos un/a Data Analyst / BI que no solo construya dashboards, sino que se responsabilice del dato: su calidad, consistencia y uso real en la organización.




La persona seleccionada será responsable de transformar datos en información accionable para la toma de decisiones, así como de operar, mantener y explotar el ecosistema de datos y reporting en Microsoft Fabric. También contribuirá al gobierno del dato en su dimensión operativa, trabajando en coordinación con el CDTO, el Data Architect y las áreas de negocio.




Este rol será el punto de unión entre la estrategia de datos, la arquitectura técnica y el uso real del dato por parte de la organización.




Responsabilidades principales





Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards corporativos en Power BI.
Participar en la evolución del Cuadro de Mando Integral corporativo.
Automatizar procesos de reporting, reduciendo la dependencia de Excel y favoreciendo modelos centralizados y fiables.
Asegurar que los informes y dashboards estén alineados con los KPIs oficiales de la compañía y con una visión de Single Source of Truth.
Construir, mantener y validar datasets en Microsoft Fabric.
Gestionar y evolucionar modelos semánticos para facilitar el consumo de datos por parte de negocio.
Validar pipelines de datos en coordinación con el Data Architect.
Asegurar que los datos utilizados en BI sean correctos, estén actualizados y sean consistentes entre las distintas áreas.
Este perfil no será responsable de diseñar la arquitectura de datos, pero sí de operarla, validarla y explotarla en el día a día.
Aplicar los estándares de gobierno del dato definidos por el CDTO.
Mantener actualizadas las definiciones de KPIs, el diccionario de datos y la trazabilidad básica de los datos.
Detectar inconsistencias, errores o problemas de calidad en los datos.
Coordinarse con Data Owners y áreas de negocio para resolver incoherencias y asegurar la fiabilidad de la información.
Ser la primera línea de detección de problemas de datos en el uso diario.
Participar junto con negocio en la definición y revisión de métricas clave.
Documentar KPIs, incluyendo fórmula, fuente, periodicidad, interpretación y criterios de uso.
Velar por la consistencia de las métricas entre áreas, informes y comités.
Realizar análisis ad-hoc sobre clientes, producto, operaciones, actividad comercial u otras áreas de negocio.
Identificar patrones, desviaciones, oportunidades de mejora e insights relevantes.
Preparar análisis e informes para Dirección y Comité de Dirección.
Participar en la elaboración de presentaciones ejecutivas basadas en datos.
Facilitar que el dato se utilice de forma efectiva en la toma de decisiones de la organización.






Requisitos técnicos




Imprescindible
Nivel alto de Power BI.
Nivel medio-alto de SQL.
Conocimiento sólido de modelado de datos, especialmente modelos en estrella o star schema.
Excel avanzado.
Capacidad para trabajar con datasets, métricas, fuentes de datos y modelos de reporting corporativo.


Muy valorable
Experiencia con Microsoft Fabric.
Conocimiento de pipelines, procesos ETL/ELT y datasets empresariales.
Experiencia en validación, calidad y consistencia de datos.
Conocimiento de modelos semánticos y buenas prácticas de BI corporativo.
Experiencia trabajando con Data Owners, equipos de tecnología y áreas de negocio.






Competencias personales




Buscamos una persona analítica, rigurosa y orientada a negocio, con capacidad para entender tanto la parte técnica como las necesidades reales de los usuarios.
Será especialmente importante contar con una verdadera mentalidad de propietario/a del dato: alguien que detecta problemas, los investiga, los persigue y no los deja pasar.
Además, valoraremos positivamente:
Capacidad para comunicar información compleja de forma clara.
Orientación a la mejora continua.
Autonomía y proactividad.
Atención al detalle.
Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes áreas de negocio.
Pensamiento crítico y orientación a la calidad.
Interés por construir una cultura de datos sólida y fiable.



Qué ofrecemos




Incorporación a un área estratégica dentro de la compañía.
Participación directa en la evolución del modelo de datos, reporting y gobierno del dato de Balantia.
Un rol con impacto real en la toma de decisiones.
Colaboración cercana con Dirección, Tecnología y áreas de negocio.
Oportunidad de trabajar con herramientas modernas del ecosistema Microsoft, incluyendo Power BI y Microsoft Fabric.

Title: Data Analyst - Madrid
Description:
¿Quieres formar parte del equipo de Serveo?




Si quieres que cada día sea diferente, enfrentándote a nuevos desafíos y formando parte de un equipo que te permita desarrollar todas tus capacidades, ¡sigue leyendo!




En Serveo somos un equipo multidisciplinar, diverso e inclusivo, formado por más de 48.000 profesionales. Somos un referente en servicios deindustria, salud, corporate, government e infraestructuras ofreciendo soluciones integrales, innovadoras y sostenibles.




Sonreímos al cambio y afrontamos juntos cada nuevo reto, impulsando la excelencia de nuestros servicios y fomentando el crecimiento de nuestros equipos en un extraordinario ambiente de trabajo.




¡Estamos orgullosos/as de ser reconocidos como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España por Actualidad Económica (El Mundo) y por Forbes y de estar en el Top 5 del Happy Trainees en 2025!







¿En qué consiste el puesto?




Buscamos un Data Analyst en Madrid, cuya misión será transformar los datos en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones en la organización, analizando, interpretando y visualizando información procedente de múltiples fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.




Funciones a desarrollar:




Analizar y explorar datos, identificando tendencias, patrones y oportunidades que aporten valor al negocio.
Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar cuadros de mando e informes, utilizando herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI) para facilitar la toma de decisiones.
Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos, colaborando con las distintas áreas para definir métricas e indicadores clave (KPIs).
Garantizar la calidad y coherencia de los análisis, validando la integridad de los datos tanto en origen como en el Data Warehouse y asegurando la correcta interpretación de los resultados.
Colaborar con otros perfiles de datos, asegurando la disponibilidad, calidad y adecuación de los datos necesarios para el análisis.
Documentar métricas, indicadores y definiciones, manteniendo un catálogo claro y consistente que facilite el autoservicio analítico.
Impulsar la cultura del dato y el autoservicio, apoyando a los equipos de negocio en el uso autónomo de las herramientas analíticas.
Apoyar la toma de decisiones basada en datos, presentando conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.
Aplicar estándares de gobierno, calidad y seguridad del dato, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas en el tratamiento de la información.
Analizar y comprender la información de negocio de forma integral, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo nuevos indicadores, análisis y cuadros de mando que aporten valor a la organización.
Participar en la definición e implantación de controles y mecanismos de calidad del dato, monitorizando la información y estableciendo procesos de alerta y comunicación con los Data Owners ante la detección de incidencias o anomalías.
Colaborar en el diseño y evolución de datasets analíticos y modelos de datos orientados al reporting y al autoservicio, participando en procesos de integración y transformación de datos.







¿Qué buscamos?




Grado en ingeniería informática, matemáticas, estadística, ADE o similar
Experiencia sólida en análisis de datos y dominio de SQL para la consulta, explotación y optimización de datos.
Dominio de herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI).
Conocimiento de arquitecturas de datos en plataformas cloud, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Knowledge Catalog, etc.).
Conocimiento de Python para análisis, tratamiento y automatización de datos.
Inglés (Avanzado)
Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, Business Intelligence o analítica de datos en entornos corporativos con las tecnologías mencionadas.
Perfil con capacidad analítica, comunicación, orientación a resultados, mejora continua, atención al detalle, autonomía y proactividad, trabajo en equipo







¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Contrato indefinido: te ofrecemos un proyecto a largo plazo en una empresa líder en servicios de infraestructuras.




Flexibilidad para facilitar la conciliación. Serveo ha sido galardonada con el Certificado EFR de la Fundación Más Familia, por su implicación en la conciliación personal, familiar y laboral. En este puesto tendrás:
Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salida
Jornada continua en verano y festividades
Política corporativa de teletrabajo

Title: Data Analyst / BI — Data Operations + BI
Description:
Sobre Balantia




En Balantia estamos reforzando nuestra Dirección del Dato y Tecnología para seguir impulsando una cultura basada en datos, decisiones informadas y procesos más eficientes. Buscamos una persona que quiera tener un rol clave en la evolución de nuestro ecosistema de datos, reporting y business intelligence.




Misión del puesto




Buscamos un/a Data Analyst / BI que no solo construya dashboards, sino que se responsabilice del dato: su calidad, consistencia y uso real en la organización.




La persona seleccionada será responsable de transformar datos en información accionable para la toma de decisiones, así como de operar, mantener y explotar el ecosistema de datos y reporting en Microsoft Fabric. También contribuirá al gobierno del dato en su dimensión operativa, trabajando en coordinación con el CDTO, el Data Architect y las áreas de negocio.




Este rol será el punto de unión entre la estrategia de datos, la arquitectura técnica y el uso real del dato por parte de la organización.




Responsabilidades principales





Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards corporativos en Power BI.
Participar en la evolución del Cuadro de Mando Integral corporativo.
Automatizar procesos de reporting, reduciendo la dependencia de Excel y favoreciendo modelos centralizados y fiables.
Asegurar que los informes y dashboards estén alineados con los KPIs oficiales de la compañía y con una visión de Single Source of Truth.
Construir, mantener y validar datasets en Microsoft Fabric.
Gestionar y evolucionar modelos semánticos para facilitar el consumo de datos por parte de negocio.
Validar pipelines de datos en coordinación con el Data Architect.
Asegurar que los datos utilizados en BI sean correctos, estén actualizados y sean consistentes entre las distintas áreas.
Este perfil no será responsable de diseñar la arquitectura de datos, pero sí de operarla, validarla y explotarla en el día a día.
Aplicar los estándares de gobierno del dato definidos por el CDTO.
Mantener actualizadas las definiciones de KPIs, el diccionario de datos y la trazabilidad básica de los datos.
Detectar inconsistencias, errores o problemas de calidad en los datos.
Coordinarse con Data Owners y áreas de negocio para resolver incoherencias y asegurar la fiabilidad de la información.
Ser la primera línea de detección de problemas de datos en el uso diario.
Participar junto con negocio en la definición y revisión de métricas clave.
Documentar KPIs, incluyendo fórmula, fuente, periodicidad, interpretación y criterios de uso.
Velar por la consistencia de las métricas entre áreas, informes y comités.
Realizar análisis ad-hoc sobre clientes, producto, operaciones, actividad comercial u otras áreas de negocio.
Identificar patrones, desviaciones, oportunidades de mejora e insights relevantes.
Preparar análisis e informes para Dirección y Comité de Dirección.
Participar en la elaboración de presentaciones ejecutivas basadas en datos.
Facilitar que el dato se utilice de forma efectiva en la toma de decisiones de la organización.






Requisitos técnicos




Imprescindible
Nivel alto de Power BI.
Nivel medio-alto de SQL.
Conocimiento sólido de modelado de datos, especialmente modelos en estrella o star schema.
Excel avanzado.
Capacidad para trabajar con datasets, métricas, fuentes de datos y modelos de reporting corporativo.


Muy valorable
Experiencia con Microsoft Fabric.
Conocimiento de pipelines, procesos ETL/ELT y datasets empresariales.
Experiencia en validación, calidad y consistencia de datos.
Conocimiento de modelos semánticos y buenas prácticas de BI corporativo.
Experiencia trabajando con Data Owners, equipos de tecnología y áreas de negocio.






Competencias personales




Buscamos una persona analítica, rigurosa y orientada a negocio, con capacidad para entender tanto la parte técnica como las necesidades reales de los usuarios.
Será especialmente importante contar con una verdadera mentalidad de propietario/a del dato: alguien que detecta problemas, los investiga, los persigue y no los deja pasar.
Además, valoraremos positivamente:
Capacidad para comunicar información compleja de forma clara.
Orientación a la mejora continua.
Autonomía y proactividad.
Atención al detalle.
Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes áreas de negocio.
Pensamiento crítico y orientación a la calidad.
Interés por construir una cultura de datos sólida y fiable.



Qué ofrecemos




Incorporación a un área estratégica dentro de la compañía.
Participación directa en la evolución del modelo de datos, reporting y gobierno del dato de Balantia.
Un rol con impacto real en la toma de decisiones.
Colaboración cercana con Dirección, Tecnología y áreas de negocio.
Oportunidad de trabajar con herramientas modernas del ecosistema Microsoft, incluyendo Power BI y Microsoft Fabric.

Title: Data Analyst / BI — Data Operations + BI
Description:
Sobre Balantia




En Balantia estamos reforzando nuestra Dirección del Dato y Tecnología para seguir impulsando una cultura basada en datos, decisiones informadas y procesos más eficientes. Buscamos una persona que quiera tener un rol clave en la evolución de nuestro ecosistema de datos, reporting y business intelligence.




Misión del puesto




Buscamos un/a Data Analyst / BI que no solo construya dashboards, sino que se responsabilice del dato: su calidad, consistencia y uso real en la organización.




La persona seleccionada será responsable de transformar datos en información accionable para la toma de decisiones, así como de operar, mantener y explotar el ecosistema de datos y reporting en Microsoft Fabric. También contribuirá al gobierno del dato en su dimensión operativa, trabajando en coordinación con el CDTO, el Data Architect y las áreas de negocio.




Este rol será el punto de unión entre la estrategia de datos, la arquitectura técnica y el uso real del dato por parte de la organización.




Responsabilidades principales





Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards corporativos en Power BI.
Participar en la evolución del Cuadro de Mando Integral corporativo.
Automatizar procesos de reporting, reduciendo la dependencia de Excel y favoreciendo modelos centralizados y fiables.
Asegurar que los informes y dashboards estén alineados con los KPIs oficiales de la compañía y con una visión de Single Source of Truth.
Construir, mantener y validar datasets en Microsoft Fabric.
Gestionar y evolucionar modelos semánticos para facilitar el consumo de datos por parte de negocio.
Validar pipelines de datos en coordinación con el Data Architect.
Asegurar que los datos utilizados en BI sean correctos, estén actualizados y sean consistentes entre las distintas áreas.
Este perfil no será responsable de diseñar la arquitectura de datos, pero sí de operarla, validarla y explotarla en el día a día.
Aplicar los estándares de gobierno del dato definidos por el CDTO.
Mantener actualizadas las definiciones de KPIs, el diccionario de datos y la trazabilidad básica de los datos.
Detectar inconsistencias, errores o problemas de calidad en los datos.
Coordinarse con Data Owners y áreas de negocio para resolver incoherencias y asegurar la fiabilidad de la información.
Ser la primera línea de detección de problemas de datos en el uso diario.
Participar junto con negocio en la definición y revisión de métricas clave.
Documentar KPIs, incluyendo fórmula, fuente, periodicidad, interpretación y criterios de uso.
Velar por la consistencia de las métricas entre áreas, informes y comités.
Realizar análisis ad-hoc sobre clientes, producto, operaciones, actividad comercial u otras áreas de negocio.
Identificar patrones, desviaciones, oportunidades de mejora e insights relevantes.
Preparar análisis e informes para Dirección y Comité de Dirección.
Participar en la elaboración de presentaciones ejecutivas basadas en datos.
Facilitar que el dato se utilice de forma efectiva en la toma de decisiones de la organización.






Requisitos técnicos




Imprescindible
Nivel alto de Power BI.
Nivel medio-alto de SQL.
Conocimiento sólido de modelado de datos, especialmente modelos en estrella o star schema.
Excel avanzado.
Capacidad para trabajar con datasets, métricas, fuentes de datos y modelos de reporting corporativo.


Muy valorable
Experiencia con Microsoft Fabric.
Conocimiento de pipelines, procesos ETL/ELT y datasets empresariales.
Experiencia en validación, calidad y consistencia de datos.
Conocimiento de modelos semánticos y buenas prácticas de BI corporativo.
Experiencia trabajando con Data Owners, equipos de tecnología y áreas de negocio.






Competencias personales




Buscamos una persona analítica, rigurosa y orientada a negocio, con capacidad para entender tanto la parte técnica como las necesidades reales de los usuarios.
Será especialmente importante contar con una verdadera mentalidad de propietario/a del dato: alguien que detecta problemas, los investiga, los persigue y no los deja pasar.
Además, valoraremos positivamente:
Capacidad para comunicar información compleja de forma clara.
Orientación a la mejora continua.
Autonomía y proactividad.
Atención al detalle.
Capacidad para trabajar con diferentes áreas de negocio.
Pensamiento crítico y orientación a la calidad.
Interés por construir una cultura de datos sólida y fiable.



Qué ofrecemos




Incorporación a un área estratégica dentro de la compañía.
Participación directa en la evolución del modelo de datos, reporting y gobierno del dato de Balantia.
Un rol con impacto real en la toma de decisiones.
Colaboración cercana con Dirección, Tecnología y áreas de negocio.
Oportunidad de trabajar con herramientas modernas del ecosistema Microsoft, incluyendo Power BI y Microsoft Fabric.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.


Join us and discover a workplace where career growth, collaboration, and enjoyment can all exist together.

Title: Data Analyst Intern
Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

YOUR MISSION

You will be at the heart of Glovo's Global Logistics and Operations team, owning the data work behind how we design, test, and optimize the order compensation structures that reward our riders across 23 countries. This is one of the highest impact areas in the company, rider payments are our largest operational cost, and every model you build or experiment you run translates directly into business outcomes at scale.

The environment is fast moving. Priorities shift and ad hoc requests come in regularly. This internship is built for someone curious, hands-on, and eager to learn how real operational decisions get made with data. You will be paired with experienced analysts who will mentor you along the way.

THE JOURNEY


Support the team in modelling and reviewing order payment structures that improve engagement and operational efficiency.
You will be using SQL to query large datasets to surface trends, answer business questions quickly, and build the analytical foundation for strategic decisions.
Translate findings into action. You will help present insights to non-technical stakeholders in a way that is concise and convincing.
Support the design and running of experiments that validate setting changes before global rollout. You will be exposed to the full cycle: design, execution, and analysis.
Leverage AI in your workflow. You will actively incorporate AI tools (agents, copilots, and LLM-assisted analysis) into your day to day work to move faster and work smarter.
Monitor and iterate. Track KPIs, spot anomalies, and make data driven adjustments on an ongoing basis.
Understand the rider perspective to ensure models are fair, locally relevant, and operationally sound.


Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE


Recently completed a degree or master's in Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
SQL is essential. You can write queries to pull and filter data, join tables, and aggregate results on your own.
Python familiarity. You can use pandas (or similar) to manipulate data and automate simple tasks.
Excel / spreadsheet familiarity. You know your way around formulas, pivot tables, and structuring data cleanly.
Strong problem-solving instincts. You can take an ambiguous question, break it down, and work toward a clear answer without waiting to be told exactly how.
Fluent English is a must. You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.


Nice-to-haves


Hands-on experience leveraging AI in your workflow: copilots, agents, or LLM-assisted analysis used to move faster and work smarter.
Exposure to data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
Any exposure to experimentation (A/B testing, switchback tests, or similar).


We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!
👪 Enhanced parental leave, and office-based nursery.
🧠 Online therapy and wellbeing benefits to ensure your mental well-being.


Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds - all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard.

Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life?

Title: DATA ANALYST
Description:
About

Joko helps consumers shop smarter. Their ambition is to revolutionize how people shop, empowering them to find what they need, make informed decisions, and save money.

Joko is a tech company founded in Paris. Their team of 105+ talents is international and spread across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, with some working remotely.

As a certified B Corporation, they are committed to making a difference for the communities they serve, including the 6 million consumers already using Joko to save money every day at over 10,000 merchants.

Over the years, they have expanded their value proposition to help consumers make smarter shopping decisions with features such as cash back, buy now pay later, automatic coupons, price drop alerts, carbon footprint tracking, and more. Today, they are dedicating significant resources to an AI-powered assistant that helps users find the right product based on criteria like price, quality, or environmental impact across the global e-commerce catalog.

After reaching profitability in their core market, they are expanding internationally with a primary focus on the US.

It’s still day 1 at Joko; come build the future of shopping with Joko.

Job Description

At Joko, we help consumers shop smarter. Our mission is to revolutionize shopping, empowering people to find what they need, make informed decisions, and save money.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 105 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 6 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts and carbon tracking, we keep expanding our products to make shopping smarter. We’re now building an AI-powered shopping assistant to help users find the best products by price, quality, and environmental impact.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

🧚🏻 Our Data team

The Data team at Joko is turning mountains of data into actionable insights for all the teams! The Data team is part of our Operations department led by our COO, and our mission is to empower the company to make informed decisions.

More Specifically, The Team's Responsibilities Are


State-of-the-art analytics & data science: We want to be at the forefront of analytics and data science by building top-notch analyses and tools. Our goal is to allow teams to leverage powerful insights from advanced reporting and predictive models.
AI-driven autonomy for stakeholders: We are doubling down on the combination of AI and data to unlock a new level of autonomy for our stakeholders, seamlessly bridging data insights with the AI tools we use, built on secure and trustworthy foundations.
Spread the data culture: At Joko, we have a strong engineering and tech culture across all teams. We work hand-in-hand with our stakeholders, providing support and training on data tools, and building close relationships to ensure our solutions align perfectly with their operational needs and evolve with them over time.


🎯 What you will do

As a Data Analyst, you will have a cross-functional role and collaborate closely with teams to understand our data and develop insights.


Advanced analytics & data science: You will explore and analyze data to uncover trends, patterns, and potential issues that will support decision-making processes across all teams. You will also contribute to data science initiatives by building predictive models and applying statistics to generate deeper insights and drive measurable business impact.
Reporting and Data Visualization: You will design and create dashboards and data visualizations that empower stakeholders to explore data autonomously. Leveraging AI tools to move faster, your focus will be on what matters most: defining the right metrics, surfacing meaningful insights, and ensuring data is understood and acted upon across the company.
AI and data integration: You will actively contribute to bridging our data with the AI tools we use, ensuring insights are integrated and maintained over time.
Stakeholder collaboration: You will work hand-in-hand with stakeholders to understand their needs, collect their feedback, and evangelize data usage to help them make smarter choices and become more autonomous over time.
Continuous Learning and Improvement: As "never stop learning" is one of our values, you will grow along the way and keep up with the latest analytical methods, AI developments, and tools in our data stack.


👀 Who we're looking for


Experience: You have 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis (relevant internships can count). We hire across different seniority levels, so we encourage you to apply even if you are more experienced.
Interest in AI: You are genuinely curious about AI and its applications, and eager to leverage it in your day-to-day work to move faster and create more impact.
Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you are willing to get better every day to reach excellence.
Problem-solving & Analytical skills: You love solving complex problems and analyzing data.
Coding knowledge: Mastering SQL and Python is not mandatory, as you can still learn when joining, but it's a plus.
Business acumen: You can understand the needs of your business stakeholders and get the big picture of how the business is running.
Communication: You know how to present your conclusions clearly and concisely (written and oral).
Education: You have graduated from a top-tier business or engineering school.
Languages: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.


💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:


Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.
Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.


On Top Of That, We Offer Plenty Of Perks


💸 Top-market compensation
📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build
🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills
🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings
💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription
🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent
…and much more, check the full list here!


🤝 Our hiring process


Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.
Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).
Step 2 – Role-specific assessments
For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).
For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).
Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.
References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Additional Information


Contract Type: Full-Time
Location: Paris, Barcelona
Possible full remote
Salary: between 48000€ and 84000€ / year
