Title: Data Analyst (Python, SQL, Power BI)
Description:
Mission

We are looking for a detail-oriented Data Analyst to transform raw data into actionable insights that support business decision-making. The role focuses on analyzing large datasets using SQL and Python and presenting findings through Power BI dashboards. You will partner closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data-driven solutions. This position requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate insights clearly. You will also contribute to improving data quality, reporting processes, and overall data maturity across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy
Analyze datasets using SQL and Python to identify trends and insights
Build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver solutions
Monitor data quality and suggest improvements to data processes
Document methodologies, analysis, and key findings


Requirements


Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role
Strong skills in SQL and Python (e.g., pandas, numpy)
Experience with Power BI for dashboards and reporting
Solid understanding of data modelling and ETL concepts
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Ability to translate data into business insights
Fluent in english

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
Ready to make an impact in the connected vehicle and telematics industry through data?

As an Associate Data Analyst at Webfleet, a Bridgestone company, you'll turn complex data into actionable insights that support business decisions. Working within the Marketing Strategy team, you'll analyze product, sales, revenue, pricing, customer, and usage data to create reports and dashboards that drive business performance.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including data analysts, product managers, marketers, sales, customer success, and business managers to deliver reliable reporting and analytics.

Your day-to-day:

As an Associate Data Analyst, you are on the forefront driving business results by generating data-based insights.


Data mining and data analyses to generate new insights for well-informed business decisions with the stakeholder support.
Collect data from multiple sources and databases and consolidate it in a single data source to generate business reports (usually Power BI, but also Tableau, Salsforce reports, or simliar visualization tools)
Identify, analyze, and interpret trends in complex datasets.
Develop powerful reports and business dashboards with excellent user experience to take business decisions.
Steering efforts to exploit new data types and sources internally.
Project Management of business initiatives end-2-end. For example, prepare analytics but also prepare presentation to defend the topic in front of the business unit management, initially with the coach and support of a team lead.
Business Analysis Capabilities: Analytical Problem-Solving capabilities, Ability to conduct Interpersonal and consultative interactions, excellent oral and written communication.
Close collaboration with Line of Business Management, sales teams, customer success, Product Managers, data scientists, marketeers, data engineers and analysts to improve business performance on KPIs as customer upsell and churn, prospecting, and rich-data content generation.



Who are you?

There is no set route to become our new Associate Data Analyst. But to be successful in this role, this is the kind of profile we have in mind:


You have at least 3 years’ experience in building dashboards and handling data sets, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, and Power BI Service (workspace management, report publishing, app publishing, and scheduled refreshes).
You can utilize several data sources, especially relational databases. This includes having knowledge in SQL.
You have experience visualizing and presenting data utilizing Power BI (Marketing Cloud Intelligence, Tableau, QlickView, are a plus).
You have knowledge in DAX Formulas, Power Query and , data modelling, and data visualization, since this will be part of the day to day job.
Be ready to be exposed to frameworks, standards, and software categories such as Azure or similar.
Personal must-haves: problem-solving skills, analytic mind, aim to learn, flexible thinking, accountability, and good communication skills.
Bachelors in science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics degree, with special focus on data analytics or and statistics.
Fluent in English. Additional language is a plus.
Would be a plus:
Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms, Mixpanel, and reporting tools.
Knowledge of statistics, Python (or another object-oriented programming language), and basic machine learning concepts.
Familiarity with Scrum or other Agile ways of working.
Ability to independently own projects and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.



Why you’ll love working for us:


The chance to work in a fast moving, innovative and international team, dealing with different countries and cultures;
A company culture that likes to work hard and play hard. We like to have fun. There is no sense coming to a job everyday if you don’t like the people you work with;
Decisive actions. We don’t like to wait. It’s in our DNA to move forward. So, it only makes sense that we don’t jam the company with lots of layers. We make things happen. Quickly.



Let’s not forget the good stuff!


Working from home up to 3 days a week.
500 euros gross to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance
Chance to work abroad for 40 working days per year
Birthday off and volunteering time off.
Additional health and dental insurance.
100% employer funded pension scheme.
Lunch, childcare or transportation vouchers.
Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning.
Access to Gofluent platform to learn new languages.
Free access to CALM (top mental health app).
Employee Assistance Program.
Discount on Bridgestone tyres.



Who are we?

Webfleet is Bridgestone’s globally trusted fleet management solution. More than 50,000 businesses across the world use it to improve fleet efficiency, support drivers, boost safety, stay compliant and work more sustainably. For more than 25 years it has been empowering fleet managers with data-driven insights that help them optimize their operations.

Webfleet contributes towards the delivery of The Bridgestone E8 Commitment. This broad, global corporate commitment clearly defines the value Bridgestone is promising to deliver to society, customers and future generations in eight focus areas: Energy, Ecology, Efficiency, Extension, Economy, Emotion, Ease and Empowerment. These provide a compass to guide strategic priorities, decision making and actions throughout every area of the business.

More information at: webfleet.com. Follow us on X: @WebfleetNews and LinkedIn @Webfleet. For more information on Bridgestone corporation visit Bridgestone.com or the Bridgestone Newsroom.

If that’s a yes, please apply and upload your CV (In English)

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
The Role

As a Data Analyst, you’ll help our customers get up and running on Affinity by importing their data and setting up the platform to support their workflows. You’ll work closely with our Onboarding, Implementation, and Customer Success teams, and play a key role in communicating directly with customers to gather requirements, set expectations, and deliver clear, actionable reports that demonstrate the value of their data setup.

What you’ll do:


Import and transform customer CSV data into Affinity and configure tables, lists, and fields so that customers can hit the ground running.
Manage the data import queue with discipline — tracking status, ETA, priority, and next steps for every import.
Clean, deduplicate, and validate data to ensure high-quality imports.
Work with Onboarding and Implementation teams to map customer data to Affinity’s data model.
Lead requirements-gathering conversations with customers to understand their data structures, workflows, and reporting needs.
Translate customer requirements into well-structured data configurations and reports that align with their business goals.
Build and deliver clear reports and dashboards for customers that surface key insights from their imported data.
Communicate proactively with customers to clarify data formats, align on timelines, and keep stakeholders informed throughout the onboarding process.
Leverage AI tools to automate and templatize repeatable workflows.


What we’re looking for:

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Affinity, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply anyways.


2-3 years of experience in data analysis, operations, or a related field.
Excel / Google Sheets power user — comfortable with VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and text manipulation.
Strong client communication skills, with the ability to lead requirements-gathering conversations, ask the right questions, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Confident communicator who can present data findings and reports to non-technical stakeholders in a clear, concise way.
Strong attention to detail with a quality-first mindset.
Familiarity with CRM platforms or database concepts (fields, records, relationships).
Organized and able to manage multiple imports with competing deadlines.
Manage the data import queue with discipline — tracking status, ETA, priority, and next steps for every import.
Experience with data analytics, reporting, or dashboard building (Looker, Tableau, or similar).


Nice to have:


Experience in B2B SaaS, customer onboarding, or professional services.


About Affinity

With more than 3,000 customers worldwide and backed by some of Silicon Valley's best firms, Affinity has raised $120M to empower dealmakers to find, manage, and close more deals. How? Our Relationship Intelligence platform uses the wealth of data exhaust from trillions of interactions between Investment Bankers, Venture Capitalists, Consultants, and other strategic dealmakers to deliver automated relationship insights that drive over 450,000 deals every month. We are are proud to have received Inc. and Fortune Best Workplaces awards as well as to be Great Places to Work certified for the last 5 years running. Join us on our mission to make it possible for anyone to cultivate and fully harness their network to succeed.

Title: Data Analyst - Ops
Description:
Embark on an exciting career journey with Optima, recognized as one of the 1000 fastest-growing companies in Europe. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Data Analyt to join our vibrant team.




About Us:




At Optima, we've had a front row seat to the fundamental changes of this industry we know and love. Whether it's a move from third-party data to first-party data, being ahead of the curve in programmatic, and preparing for a new cookieless world, we pride ourselves in removing the hassle. Our publishers can count on revenue streams that are optimized and predictable, so they can continue doing what they do best: inform and entertain global consumers.




Job Description

As a Data Analyst, you'll own the numbers behind our publisher portfolio. You'll turn raw programmatic data into decisions: which publishers to onboard, where revenue is leaking, which levers move yield, and what our commercial teams should do next.

This is a high-ownership role with direct, measurable impact on revenue. You'll work daily with Business Development, Operations, and Demand, and you'll build deep expertise in the programmatic supply chain — SSPs, DSPs, header bidding, ads.txt — from day one. If you want to become genuinely fluent in ad tech data, there are few faster ways to do it.




Responsibilities:




Analysis & insight

Analyze prospective publishers: size the revenue opportunity, model expected yield, and pressure-test assumptions before we commit
Run deep-dive analyses on portfolio performance — yield by placement, format, geo, device, and demand partner — and translate findings into concrete recommendations
Build and maintain the metrics that define how we measure success, and defend their definitions when they're questioned
Identify patterns across publishers that others miss: seasonality, demand-partner behavior, bid-density shifts, traffic-quality signals

Performance monitoring & optimization

Monitor daily performance across the portfolio (impressions, fill rate, CPM, CTR, viewability, revenue) against targets
Catch underperformance early, diagnose root causes with data rather than intuition, and make or recommend the adjustments that fix it
Troubleshoot delivery and discrepancy issues with internal teams and external partners, tracing numbers back through the stack to find where they diverge




Publisher onboarding, technical integration and account operations

Support technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Assist the Business Development team with new-publisher onboarding and keep the new-business pipeline data accurate and up to date in our CRM
Support adoption of our sales tools and processes across the region

Data quality & reporting

Own the integrity of our reporting layer: audit dashboards and data sources regularly, reconcile discrepancies between platforms, and escalate anomalies fast
Automate recurring reporting so the team spends its time on decisions, not on assembling spreadsheets
Produce clear, accurate performance reporting for publishers and internal stakeholders — and make sure the story the numbers tell is the right one
Surface insights and trends that feed commercial and product decisions
Onboarding & technical integration
Support the technical setup of new publishers: ads.txt, ad tags, header bidding configuration, and QA before go-live
Work with Business Development on new-publisher onboarding, and keep pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM










Required Skills and Qualifications:

Strong analytical skills, identify trends and make data-driven decisions and knowledge of the ad-tech universe.
Proficiency with office productivity tools; ability to quickly adapt to new software and systems.
Proficiency in ad serving platforms.
Commitment to maintaining confidentiality regarding company and employee information.
Fluent in English.



Benefits:

Hybrid work model from our Barcelona office. (3 days at the office / 2 days remote)
Remote working during August.
Real ownership from week one, with structured onboarding and mentorship from senior operators.
A clear growth path.
Front-row exposure to a fast-scaling company working with leading publishers.
Paid team lunch every week.

Title: Finance Data Analyst
Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are now looking for a Data Analyst for Finance to join our team in Barcelona (hybrid). The Finance Data Analytics team has been transformative during the last two years by helping our stakeholders succeed in their mission. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform

and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.


Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – 7.7M members in Prime since launching in 2017.
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription program, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalized service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Finance Data Analyst you will be in charge of:


Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and including taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights: “Contribute to the Finance strategic roadmap with numbers”
Elaborate business cases to support strategic decisions
Create dashboards and tracking: master the internal Business Intelligence tools to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage all our internal data
Contribute to the delivery of Finance strategic projects: participate in the delivery of the key internal projects, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes.



what do you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
2-4 years experience in a role with strong analytical component
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement,
Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc)
Strong analytical skills, fast-learner, with high attention to detail and focused on results and productivity
Business Proficiency in English and fluent in Spanish
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Looker Studio),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management (as Google Cloud Platform),
SAP knowledge.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



and what's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, paddle tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Title: Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Finance)
Description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Finance), you will be:


Understanding Finance business challenges and translating them into structured functional requirements
Gathering, analysing, and prioritising requirements through stakeholder workshops, and producing detailed functional specifications for BI & Analytics solutions
Defining data models and business objects with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, applying dimensional modeling (star schema, facts, dimensions, KPIs, semantic models)

Upholding data governance, business rules, documentation, and data-quality standards, and driving user adoption of BI/Data best practices

Experience on Finance projects is a must
Experience with modern analytics platforms such as Power BI, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data platforms
Good understanding of dimensional data modeling and BI semantic models / analytical reporting platforms
Fluent French (mandatory) and a good professional level of English
Based in or able to work on-site in Barcelona from the beginning of September

Benefits

What we offer


A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind

An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Desenvolupar dashboards i informes en Power BI i altres eines similars orientats a la presa de decisions.
Modelar i estructurar dades per garantir la seva coherència, qualitat i usabilitat.
Dissenyar visualitzacions clares, intuïtives i amb criteri estètic.
Traduir necessitats clíniques i de gestió en indicadors i quadres de comandament.
Col·laborar amb l’equip per garantir una visió integrada i coherent de la informació.

Jornada del 100%, de dilluns a divendres.

Experiència demostrable en Power BI (modelatge, DAX i visualització) o altres eines similars
Capacitat per organitzar, netejar i estructurar dades.

Orientació a usuari i a impacte real.

Title: Product Data Analyst | EU based/Remote
Description:
Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success - powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 5 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your day-to-day:


Partner with Product teams to tackle challenges, reveal untapped potential, challenge status-quo and empower data-driven choices.
Use Amplitude to analyse user journeys and conduct A/B tests.
Use SQL and Tableau to extract and analyze data.
Build dashboards that make an impact - create powerful visualizations that give teams at Hostinger the visibility and confidence to take action, while ensuring data integrity and validity.
Use Lumos - our internal AI data agent to surface new insights and business recommendations.
Collaborate with our top-notch Data Platform team - work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to ensure data availability, efficient processes and successful project execution.


Real projects you might work on:


Analysing AI-Powered Marketing Tool Users - our AI-powered Reach Team needs to understand product usage, user segments and conversions. Your insights could help us refine our approach and shape the future of Hostinger's Reach product. If you want to go the extra mile - some product-related user flow analysis and A/B testing would be welcome too!
Decoding AI WebMail Clients Engagement - our Mail Team is rapidly evolving the communication experience, and they require deep analytical support to fuel their growth. You will dive into customer behavior patterns, providing the strategic clarity needed to shape the next generation of Hostinger’s email solutions through data-backed innovation.
Optimizing Our Client Referral Program - As this initiative scales rapidly, your data-driven expertise will be essential in refining our commission frameworks. You will help us architect high-impact partnership strategies, ensuring we build deeper, more rewarding connections with our global client base.
Empowering Our Innovation Team - Innovation is at the core of our success. As we explore diverse new ventures, your analytical expertise will be vital in enriching these ideas with data. You will provide strategic guidance to Product Managers on whether and how to scale emerging business opportunities effectively.
Defining Product Adoption Success - We want to ensure our clients navigate our tools seamlessly and reach their objectives with ease. You will dive deep into product usage patterns and customer behavior, providing strategic recommendations to elevate the overall Hostinger experience through data-driven improvements.
And many more, depending on your skills, interests and business needs.


Your skills and experience:


2+ years of experience in a product analyst, data analyst, business analyst or similar role.
Experience with A/B testing and user journey analysis.
Hands-on SQL expertise - you can write queries, create and optimize dashboard models. Basically, Claude asks you to check queries.
Proficiency in data visualization tools - we use Tableau, but experience with other tools works too.
A results-driven mindset - you love turning raw data into clear, actionable insights that drive business impact.
Strong communication & collaboration skills - you can explain complex data in a simple way and work well with cross-functional teams.
Bonus: Experience with Amplitude or other product analytics tools.
Extra points for: experience with Python or R for data analysis, A/B testing experience or knowledge of statistical concepts.


Benefits for you:

🚀 360 Growth: We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, feedback culture, digital libraries, and industry-leading subscriptions. Advance your career with internal mobility, and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work on your terms, whether from the comfort of home or anywhere in the world. With a home office budget, you can elevate your workspace. Enjoy the flexibility to manage your schedule while bringing your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your health comes first with company-provided sick days, 20 paid suspension days, Headspace subscriptions, and recharge leave. Participate in wellbeing-dedicated events and simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness.

🎉 Work hard - party hard: Recognize hard work with company events like Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-building experiences, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations.

Compensation:

We’re looking for people who can make a meaningful impact, and we recognize that different levels of experience bring different levels of value. Compensation for this role will be discussed throughout the hiring process and tailored based on your skills, experience, and potential contribution to the team.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Title: Data & Yield Analyst
Description:
About Softonic

At Softonic, people come first. We’re a multicultural team passionate about building digital experiences used by millions of users worldwide. Guided by a fail fast, learn faster mindset, we encourage curiosity, experimentation, and continuous improvement, to make a real impact.

Our culture is shaped by four principles:


Step up: Take ownership and act with integrity.
Work smart: Focus on impact and efficiency.
One team: Collaborate openly and support each other.
Think big: Stay curious and challenge the status quo.


Team up with us to grow your career in an international, collaborative, and people-focused company where your ideas matter and your work reaches a global audience.

About The Role

We are a global premium publisher with 28 years of history, providing quality software & APPs download services across multiple languages, also expanding with white labels (Download.com Filehippo), Publisher network (rev.amp), and more partnerships on the way.

As our data & yield analyst reporting to the Director of Advertising, you will be responsible for bridging all revenue team’s data-analytics need (including but not limited to datasets, data visualization, and automation with the process for revenue generation/optimization purposes) with our BI team, to drive initiatives that will boost making more & better data-driven decisions and improve efficiency on revenue generation. Will also take the yield function to analyze market trends & discover business opportunities, not only providing insights to the relevant teams (Sales, Paid, Partnership, Adtech, Product, Traffic, etc) but also following through with the implementation of the initiatives to ensure the business impact is realized.

Key Responsibilities


Be a data champion inside the Advertising & RevOps team and the go-to-person for ithe team & stakeholders from other revenue teams when it comes to better utilization of our data.
Help revenue teams to identify opportunities: using new data points, visualization and automation solutions and ideas to improve revenue generation efficiency, take those requirements, coordinate with dev (BI or other teams) to build the roadmap for the projects & implement accordingly.
Oversee & analyze mid-long (monthly, quarterly, YoY) term yield performance/trends of revenue streams & devices, provide insights on fluctuation, alerts when needed, and recommend a clear plan of action.
Provide A/B test or lean test analysis with recommendations for revenue-related initiatives.
Manage UPR optimisation and automation of pricing recommendation tool (either 3rd party or in-house).
Be able to use agentic AI tools to automate process & streamline data processing & analytic flows to deliver results efficiently
Provide insights on market trends, opportunities, and inventory availability information to the sales & AMs team for better usage of market data
Help teams turn data into actionable insights that unlock revenue opportunities and support smarter business decisions.


Must have


At least 2 years of working experience working as business analyst, preferably with experience in digital advertising business.
Experience of working with BI platforms, like Tableau, Qlikview & advance skills of Google Analytics.
Experience of doing data analysis work with AI tools like Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Copilot, etc.
Experience of working with BigQuery, SQL & Python.
Preferable background on big data, data science related topics.
Experience building analytical models and working with structured and unstructured data sets to drive business decisions.
Knowledge of the online advertising ecosystem.
Basic understanding of budgeting, financial forecast, and accounting principles is preferred.
Excellent communication and project management skills with a strong business acumen.
Ability to work on own initiative in a fast-moving environment.
High level of motivation, determination and commitment.
An excellent command of both written and spoken English is required.


Why Softonic?


Private Health Care
Hybrid Work Model (3 days on-site per week in Poblenou area)
Flexible remote work options during certain periods of the year
Flexible Spending Plan & Free Tax Consultant
Learning & Development: Language Classes (English, Spanish, Catalan) and Training Program
Workplace Amenities: Dining Room, Gaming Room, Terraces, and complimentary fresh fruit, coffee, snacks, and drinks
Team & Social Events: Pizza & Beers every Thursday
Lifestyle Benefits: Discounts at gyms and restaurants
Additional Time Off: Birthday leave
Opt for: Mac or Windows laptop
Wellhub program

If you need any specific accommodation/adaptation due to a disability during the recruitment process, please send us an email to recruitment@softonic.com with your request and we'll contact you.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn't stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives.

By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll be the person who secures the future of digital payments by architecting sophisticated real-time defense strategies.

Title: Revenue Management Analyst
Description:
Overview

Revenue Management Analyst

Design and implement the Pack, Price and Promotion Strategy across the different channels, with the objective of maximizing PepsiCo’s Net Revenue & Profitability.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer & commercial strategy, and financial performance, ensuring the right value propositions reach the right consumers, through the right channels, at the right price and in the right formats, while balancing profitability, competitiveness, and customer needs.

This role must have close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Category teams to drive sustainable growth through data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities

Main Accountabilities:


Design and recommend Pack & Price strategies across brands and different sub-channels, grounded in insights and performance analysis
Lead Promotional strategy definition and implementation. Define the annual promo calendar, based on shopper insights to maximize performance. Perform periodic analysis to understand results & tailor the strategy.
Drive mix development initiatives to maximize Net Revenue Realization (NRR), acting as a category-wide owner of mix levers across channels and departments.
Own PPA initiatives, working together with sales, marketing & commercialization, ensuring market-fit and strategic relevance.
Lead the AOP strategy & algorithm, aligning short- and long-term initiatives to deliver volume, revenue, and profitability targets.
Create x-channel commercial policy, and define list prices for all SKUs, participating in the innovation gates.
Partner with Sales to co-create commercially sound proposals, including multipacks , bonuspacks or I&Os in order to boost volumes.
Support the implementation & adoption RGM Digital tools (e.g. elasticity, ROI, Uplift models…)
Anticipate proactively the market changes, for analysis and decision making (VAT or Tax impacts, legislations, sustainability goals..etc)
Monitor and track implemented initiatives in order to obtain learnings & insights to optimize and define future strategies.
Ensure cross-functional alignment across Sales, Trade Marketing, Insights, Finance, Marketing, Category Management, and Commercialization.


Qualifications

Experience required


At least 7 years experience in Revenue Management, Finance Planning, Insights, Commercial roles or similar.
Experience in the use of internal & external data bases (Nielsen, SAP,…)
Knowledge of RGM & finance KPIs (NR, MC, Elasticity, ROI..) preferred
Proactivity, ability to work in a cross functional environment and with collaboration spirit
Strong Microsoft Office skills (Excel and ppt)
Fluent in Spanish and English (advanced level)


Competencies Required


Good story telling and communication skills
Very strong analytical skills & high business knowledge as a broad perspective is needed to identify channel opportunities
Strategic thinking. Ability to see connection in data, anticipate potential risks/opportunities, and optimize & simplify processes.
Self-driven, able to work independently and take initiative
Team player & Proactive collaboration
Resilience and adaptability to change
Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines
Experience in stakeholder management


Why PepsiCo Iberia?

PepsiCo Iberia, part of the Western Europe Operating Unit, is home to a team of nearly 3,000 talented employees across our Barcelona, Madrid, Vitoria and Lisbon headquarters, and our production sites in Spain and Portugal.

With iconic brands like Pepsi, 7UP, Alvalle, Lay’s or Doritos, we continue to shape the food and beverage landscape as one of the region’s leading companies.

At PepsiCo, you’re not just joining a business - you’re joining a culture that champions innovation, encourages bold thinking and empowers every individual to make an impact.

Title: Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Industrial / Supply Chain)
Description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data & BI Business Analyst (Industrial / Supply Chain), you will be:


Understanding Industrial / Supply Chain business challenges and translating them into structured functional requirements
Gathering, analysing, and prioritising requirements through stakeholder workshops, and producing detailed functional specifications for BI & Analytics solutions
Defining data models and business objects with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, applying dimensional modeling (star schema, facts, dimensions, KPIs, semantic models)
Supporting UAT, validation, and ensuring business requirements are met throughout delivery
Upholding data governance, business rules, documentation, and data-quality standards, and driving user adoption of BI/Data best practices


Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:


6+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or Business Analysis. The ideal candidate now has a role of Project Manager / Delivery Coordinator.
Experience on Industrial / Supply Chain / Manufacturing projects is a must.
Experience with modern analytics platforms such as Power BI, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data platforms
Good understanding of dimensional data modeling and BI semantic models / analytical reporting platforms
Fluent French (mandatory) and a good professional level of English
Based in or able to work on-site in Barcelona from the beginning of September
Nice to have: experience in the watchmaking / luxury manufacturing industry


Benefits

Benefits

What we offer


A competitive compensation package
A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset


Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

Title: Data Analyst Intern - Business Ops Data Enablement (September 2026)
Description:
What You'll Do:

Are you passionate about turning data into impact? At Criteo, our Business Ops Data Enablement team empowers analysts across the globe to make smarter decisions through better data, tools, and collaboration.

With a community of 250+ analysts worldwide, we’ve built a company-wide coordination team to manage analytical expertise, define usage policies, and align teams across regions. Our mission is to ensure that data is used effectively, sustainably, and collaboratively.

As a Data Analyst Intern, you won’t just learn—you’ll contribute. You’ll be part of a dynamic team that connects business and tech, contribute to data pipelines, and builds tools that scale globally. This is your chance to grow your technical skills, gain real-world experience, and make a meaningful difference.

During your internship, you’ll:


Build real tools: Learn how to design and improve a platform using Python and SQL
Modernize data workflows: Get hands-on experience optimizing SQL-based ETL jobs, making data pipelines faster and more reliable.
Bridge business and tech: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into smart, scalable data solutions.
Empower a global community: Share best practices, deliver mini-trainings, and support analysts across Americas, APAC, and EMEA.
Champion data quality: Learn how to identify and fix data issues, and help define standards for excellence.
Grow with mentorship: Be coached by experienced analysts and engineers, and develop your skills in Python, SQL, and more.
Leverage LLMs: Develop the skill of writing effective prompts to boost your productivity or improve your code using LLMs like Copilot.



Who You Are:

You’re curious, collaborative, and eager to learn. You don’t need to tick every box, but you should be:


Interested in business intelligence and analytics
0–2 years data analysis experience with both technical and analytical components (Data Engineer, Data Analytics, etc.)
Basic understanding of data analysis concepts and tools (e.g. SQL).
Familiar with Python or another programming language
A problem-solver who enjoys working with data and is detailed
Comfortable presenting insights to different audiences
A team player who values community and collaboration
Fluent in English



We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!

Who We Are:

We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.

At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward-thinking environment.

We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non-job-related factors or legally protected characteristics.

What We Offer:

🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in-office experiences, making space for both.

Demonstrated experience with some or all of the following: predictive modeling, statistics, experimental design, optimization, data visualization

Title: Marketing Data Analyst - VIE - Barcelona
HTML:
Since 2015, papernest has been transforming the way people manage their contracts, making subscription, management, and switching simple through one smart, intuitive platform.

We have supported more than 2 million customers across France, Spain, and Italy. Along the way, we have continued to invest in new verticals, establishing papernest as a high-performing, innovative, and competitive scale-up in a fast-growing market.

With over 900 employees, we are strengthening our position as a European market leader.

Within the Paid Acquisition team (Marketing & Sales team department) and based in Barcelona, your mission is to analyze, optimize and scale our SEA performance for the Spanish market through a data-driven approach.

Your role consists in analyzing acquisition performance, identifying growth opportunities and optimizing our SEA campaigns to generate qualified leads for our Operations teams.

This is a strategic and highly analytical role for papernest since you will be managing one of our main acquisition channels for foreign countries. Your role will cover several areas : digital marketing, project management, SEA, data analysis and management.

Your Futures Missions

Drive performance through data analysis :

  • Analyse and monitor Spanish accounts with a data-driven (ROI-based) approach ;
  • Test new campaigns, features and bidding strategy to increase our conversion rate and make sure we keep on growing ;
  • Identify insights, prioritize and launch new test to boost our growth on these markets.

User experiences : own the whole SEA funnel for your accounts :

  • Ensure perfect content creation, integration and tracking of our landing pages ;
  • Promote a test & learn dynamic to better know our users and understand their behavior ;
  • Benchmark our competitors and others sectors to find the best practices.

Data Analysis & Performance

  • Analyze daily and weekly performance, identify trends and provide actionable recommendations to improve profitability. ;
  • Build deep-dive analyses on campaign performance and experiments to support business decisions.

About You

  • Fluent in French and English, Spanish is a plus ;
  • Business or engineering school ;
  • A first experience in the Digital Marketing field or in Consulting, previous experience in SEO/PPC is a plus ;
  • Strong analytical skills: you master Excel, SQL is a plus ;
  • Strong sense of ownership ;
  • Great interpersonal skills and great ability to communicate

What We Offer

Evolving in an international and inclusive environment: Everyone has their place at Papernest, and with over 46 different nationalities, it’s not uncommon for us to start a sentence in French and finish it in English or Spanish!

💸 Compensation: A monthly allowance defined by Business France, check for the amount in Spain, which is updated every quarter.

🩺 Health & Transport: A health insurance plan, April, for hassle-free management of your healthcare expenses, with 100% reimbursement. To make your transition easier, we also cover 100% of your round-trip transportation costs.

🧳 Luggage: No decision to make! Papernest covers 100% of your luggage fees (up to 150kg) so you can enjoy all the seasons in Barcelona.

📈 Career Development: For us, the VIE contract is a real stepping stone into professional life. We support your career ambitions by ensuring your learning and professional development throughout your experience with us.

✨ Home office: Enjoy 2 days of home office per week to optimize your focus and efficiency.

Hiring Process

  • First Call with Eva, Talent Acquisition Partner (30') ;
  • Excel case to evaluate your skills (2h) ;
  • Technical interview with Celeste, Growth Marketing Manager (1h) ;
  • Last interview with Giacomo, Chief Marketing Officer (30')

Interested in this challenge? 🙂

Don’t hesitate any longer—we look forward to meeting you! Regardless of your gender, background, religion, sexual orientation, or disability, there’s a place for you with us. Our selection processes are designed to be inclusive, and our work environment is adapted to everyone’s needs.

Title: Tècnic/a de Participació Comunitària i Ciutadana SETEMBRE Indefinit
Place: Sant Vicenç dels Horts, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
T'apassiona impulsar projectes comunitaris i fomentar la participació ciutadana?

A la Fundació Pere Tarrés busquem un/a Tècnic/a de Participació Comunitària i Ciutadana per incorporar-se al projecte Sant Vicenç en Xarxa, una iniciativa que treballa per enfortir el teixit comunitari, promoure el voluntariat i impulsar la participació activa de la ciutadania.

Cerquem una persona amb experiència en dinamització comunitària i participació ciutadana, amb capacitat per generar aliances, coordinar projectes i treballar en xarxa amb entitats, administració i agents del territori.

Quines seran les teves funcions?

Participació comunitària


Impulsar projectes que fomentin la cohesió social i el suport mutu al municipi.
Coordinar i dinamitzar la xarxa de voluntariat i les seves actuacions.
Detectar situacions de vulnerabilitat i coordinar-ne la derivació als serveis corresponents.
Promoure accions d'acompanyament a persones en situació d'aïllament social.
Treballar en xarxa amb Serveis Socials, Càritas, centres educatius, CAP, Cultura, Esports, Feminismes i altres serveis municipals.
Dissenyar i coordinar activitats comunitàries que generin vincles i participació al territori.
Elaborar protocols, eines i materials de difusió del projecte.



Participació ciutadana


Assessorar i acompanyar les entitats en la creació, desenvolupament i consolidació dels seus projectes.
Organitzar accions formatives i iniciatives per enfortir el teixit associatiu.
Donar suport als processos participatius impulsats per l'Ajuntament.
Gestionar i dinamitzar la plataforma Decidim Sant Vicenç dels Horts.
Col·laborar en la creació i consolidació d'espais, eines i mecanismes de participació ciutadana.
Treballar coordinadament amb el Departament de Participació, Civisme i Convivència.



Què t'oferim?


Contracte indefinit.
Jornada completa.
Formar part d'un projecte innovador amb impacte directe en la vida comunitària del municipi.
Treballar conjuntament amb un equip especialitzat en participació comunitària i ciutadana.
Incorporar-te a una entitat referent en l'àmbit social i comunitari.



Horari orientatiu


Dilluns, dimarts i divendres: de 8.30 h a 15.00 h.
Dimecres i dijous: de 9.30 h a 14.30 h i de 15.00 h a 19.00 h.



L'horari definitiu està pendent de validació amb l'Ajuntament i pot requerir flexibilitat puntual per activitats en caps de setmana o festius.

Centre de treball: Ajuntament de Sant Vicenç dels Horts.

Incorporació prevista: setembre de 2026.

T'hi vols sumar?

Si creus en la força de la participació per transformar els barris i vols impulsar projectes que connectin persones, entitats i administració, inscriu-te a l'oferta i forma part de la Fundació Pere Tarrés.

T'apassiona impulsar projectes comunitaris i fomentar la participació ciutadana?

A la Fundació Pere Tarrés busquem un/a Tècnic/a de Participació Comunitària i Ciutadana per incorporar-se al projecte Sant Vicenç en Xarxa, una iniciativa que treballa per enfortir el teixit comunitari, promoure el voluntariat i impulsar la participació activa de la ciutadania.

Cerquem una persona amb experiència en dinamització comunitària i participació ciutadana, amb capacitat per generar aliances, coordinar projectes i treballar en xarxa amb entitats, administració i agents del territori.

Quines seran les teves funcions?

Participació comunitària

  • Impulsar projectes que fomentin la cohesió social i el suport mutu al municipi.
  • Coordinar i dinamitzar la xarxa de voluntariat i les seves actuacions.
  • Detectar situacions de vulnerabilitat i coordinar-ne la derivació als serveis corresponents.
  • Promoure accions d'acompanyament a persones en situació d'aïllament social.
  • Treballar en xarxa amb Serveis Socials, Càritas, centres educatius, CAP, Cultura, Esports, Feminismes i altres serveis municipals.
  • Dissenyar i coordinar activitats comunitàries que generin vincles i participació al territori.
  • Elaborar protocols, eines i materials de difusió del projecte.


Participació ciutadana

  • Assessorar i acompanyar les entitats en la creació, desenvolupament i consolidació dels seus projectes.
  • Organitzar accions formatives i iniciatives per enfortir el teixit associatiu.
  • Donar suport als processos participatius impulsats per l'Ajuntament.
  • Gestionar i dinamitzar la plataforma Decidim Sant Vicenç dels Horts.
  • Col·laborar en la creació i consolidació d'espais, eines i mecanismes de participació ciutadana.
  • Treballar coordinadament amb el Departament de Participació, Civisme i Convivència.


Què t'oferim?

  • Contracte indefinit.
  • Jornada completa.
  • Formar part d'un projecte innovador amb impacte directe en la vida comunitària del municipi.
  • Treballar conjuntament amb un equip especialitzat en participació comunitària i ciutadana.
  • Incorporar-te a una entitat referent en l'àmbit social i comunitari.


Horari orientatiu

  • Dilluns, dimarts i divendres: de 8.30 h a 15.00 h.
  • Dimecres i dijous: de 9.30 h a 14.30 h i de 15.00 h a 19.00 h.


L'horari definitiu està pendent de validació amb l'Ajuntament i pot requerir flexibilitat puntual per activitats en caps de setmana o festius.

Centre de treball: Ajuntament de Sant Vicenç dels Horts.

Si creus en la força de la participació per transformar els barris i vols impulsar projectes que connectin persones, entitats i administració, inscriu-te a l'oferta i forma part de la Fundació Pere Tarrés.

Title: IT Support (Level 1)
Description:
About Olala!

Olala! is an international hospitality and real estate group, developing, owning, and operating hotels, vacation rentals, and food & beverage concepts worldwide.

Since 1996, we have built a presence in 17 cities worldwide, combining global expertise with local insight. Our mission is to deliver smart, technology-driven, and design-forward accommodations that meet the needs of today’s traveler while upholding the highest standards of service.

Your role

We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Level 1 IT Support to join our team.

As a Level 1 IT Support you will be in charge of assisting the group’s technical infrastructure.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in the vacation rental industry and contribute to the growth of our company.

Your Journey


Provide first-level technical support (hardware, software, networks).
Assist users with productivity tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365), ERP and PMS platforms, and general SaaS tools used by the company.
Log and follow up on tickets via the company’s ticketing system (e.g. Asana/Jira).
Perform basic setup and maintenance of devices.
Escalate unresolved issues to Level 2 support when necessary.


What Do You Bring To Your Trip


Basic knowledge of operating systems (Windows, macOS).
Familiarity with networking fundamentals (Wi-Fi, LAN) and basic troubleshooting.
Experience with SaaS platforms and user administration.
Familiarity with ticketing systems.
Strong customer orientation and clear communication.
Proactive attitude and ability to follow support protocols.
Working proficiency in English (spoken and written).


Life at Olala!


Breakfast is the most important meal of the day. Fruit, coffee & milk is on us!
You will have access to apply for our private healthcare after a probation period of 6 or 12 months, depending on your type of contract.
Employees know it first! You will be able to enjoy an annual credit to use in one of our accommodations around the world.
Keep learning! Career growth and development opportunities including learning programs and career plans per department and position.
Flex day: Your flexibility is important. Enjoy the possibility of working from home 1 day a week.
Events: Team buildings, office events and once a month Olala Group invites you to an afterwork!
Pet friendly days at the office - we want to meet your furry friend!


Together we revolutionize the way people travel!

Diversity and Sustainability

At Olala! we take pride in cultivating a vibrant and inclusive work environment that celebrates individuality and diversity. We believe that these are invaluable assets that fuel innovation, foster creativity and drive our overall success.

Additionally, we believe in taking action towards curving the impact that our company has on its environments. This includes implementing energy efficient practices and engaging in community projects that promote cultural preservation among others actions.

We look forward to receiving your application!

For more information about Olala! visit Olala.com and to keep up to date with Olala! news, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram!

Title: Data Analyst Consultant
Description:
En Prenomics ayudamos a nuestros clientes a tomar mejores decisiones gracias a sus datos. Buscamos un perfil capaz de entender el negocio, explorar la complejidad del dato y construir soluciones end-to-end que generen impacto tangible — desde la integración y curación de datos hasta modelos predictivos y visualizaciones con herramientas de BI. Todo ello en contacto directo con el cliente.


Tareas



Análisis del uso que hace el cliente de los datos y estratégia de negocio.


Detección de oportunidades de explotación de sus datos y de datos externos con alto impacto en su negocio.


Exploración y análisis de datos, identificación de variables relevantes para resolver retos concretos.


Estudio y modelización de la estructura global de datos del cliente.


Construcción de soluciones a problemas de negocio en base a datos de principio a fin (compresión de necesidad, integrción del dato, curación de datos, visualización con herramientas de business intelligence, construcción de algoritmos y modelos predictivos).


Comunicación de resultados e interacción directa con clientes.



Requisitos



Titulación: Grado en Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería, Química. Máster en BI, Business Analytics, Data Science, o experiencia equivalente.


Herramientas: SQL, Python


Nivel de Español hablado y escrito nativo.


Sensibilidad de negocio y pensamiento estratégico.


Fuertes habilidades analíticas


Capacidad de comunicación y presentación de resultados analíticos



Beneficios



Participar en proyectos innovadores en el ámbito del Data Science (nuestra tecnología combina BI con soluciones de machine learning adaptadas a cada cliente y con las que él mismo interacciona).


Contacto directo con los clientes y acceso a problemas reales a los que se enfrentan las empresas, diseñando soluciones con un alto impacto.


Formar parte de una startup en crecimiento y colaborar a diario con un equipo de expertos en consultoría estrategia, data science y desarrollo de software en la nube.


Trabajar con tecnologías de última generación





Beneficios Prenomics





Horario de trabajo flexible e híbrido


Suministro ilimitado de bebidas con y sin cafeína


Horas semanales dedicadas a apreder y discutir nuevas tecnologías


Sistema de retribución flexible: tickets restaurante y transporte


Evaluaciones de desempeño, diseño de plan de carrera y revisiones salariales anuales


Actividades de teambuilding con todo el equipo

Title: Creador/a de contenidos Primaria
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Sobre nosotros 🚀

Innovamat es una organización educativa centrada en el aprendizaje de las matemáticas. Su propósito es contribuir a mejorar cómo se aprende esta ciencia, ofreciendo recursos, formación e investigación a la comunidad educativa.

Fundada en 2017 en Barcelona, Innovamat cuenta con 27 000 docentes de más de 2 600 centros educativos de España, Estados Unidos, México, Italia, Chile, Ecuador, Colombia, Brasil y Perú, que hacen que más de 600 000 alumnos aprendan matemáticas fomentando la comprensión profunda y el desarrollo competencial.

Tu misión 🎯

Formarás parte de nuestro equipo de Contenidos de Primaria y desempeñarás un rol clave en el diseño, desarrollo e innovación del proyecto pedagógico. Serás responsable de transformar conceptos matemáticos profundos en experiencias de aprendizaje rigurosas, atractivas y eficaces para el aula.

Tu día a día en Innovamat 🏁


Diseño e innovación pedagógica: Crearás materiales didácticos originales y fundamentados para docentes de educación primaria, colaborando codo a codo con expertos en didáctica de las matemáticas.
Revisión y optimización: Evaluarás y elevarás la calidad de los materiales existentes (guías didácticas para docentes, recursos para el alumnado, presentaciones, guiones audiovisuales, etc.).
Coordinación vertical y transversal: Te coordinarás con los equipos de Infantil y Secundaria para garantizar la coherencia del aprendizaje a lo largo de las distintas etapas educativas.
Co-creación multidisciplinar: Trabajarás conjuntamente con los equipos de ilustración, lingüístico, maquetación y diseño instruccional para asegurar la máxima calidad técnica y formal.
Internacionalización y adaptación: Analizarás y adaptarás la propuesta curricular a diversos contextos socioculturales y normativos de otros territorios y países.
Investigación y vanguardia educativa: Mantendrás un aprendizaje continuo sobre las últimas tendencias e investigaciones en didáctica de la matemática y tecnología educativa.
Validación e investigación de campo: Visitarás escuelas para testar y evaluar los materiales en situaciones reales de aula, recogiendo feedback cualitativo de docentes y alumnado para la mejora continua.


¿Qué buscamos en ti? 🔍


Experiencia de aula: Experiencia ejerciendo como maestro/a de Educación Primaria, gestionando directamente el aprendizaje de las matemáticas en el aula. (Buscamos a alguien que conozca de primera mano las dinámicas, retos y necesidades reales del aula).
Sólido trasfondo en Didáctica de las Matemáticas:
Formación especializada (Postgrado, Máster, cursos de especialización o mención en Didáctica de las Matemáticas o STEM).
O bien, trayectoria destacada en la aplicación e implementación de metodologías activas y manipulativas para la enseñanza de las matemáticas.
Competencia lingüística: Buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita y verbal en catalán, castellano e inglés (capacidad para trabajar y crear contenido fluido en estos idiomas).
Solvencia digital: Dominio de herramientas digitales para la creación, maquetación y gestión de contenidos didácticos.
Gestión de proyectos: Capacidad demostrada para organizarse, priorizar tareas complejas y cumplir con los plazos de entrega en un entorno dinámico.
Competencias y mentalidad:
Pasión y vocación por la educación matemática: Interés genuino y continuo por la investigación pedagógica y las nuevas formas de enseñar y aprender matemáticas.
Pensamiento crítico y capacidad analítica: Criterio pedagógico firme para evaluar qué funciona en el aula y por qué.
Flexibilidad, proactividad y adaptabilidad: Mentalidad de crecimiento, comodidad ante el cambio y agilidad para iterar propuestas a partir del feedback.
Trabajo en equipo y comunicación empática: Habilidad para dar y recibir feedback constructivo con perfiles muy diversos.
Si cuentas con experiencia en el aula, pasión por revolucionar la enseñanza de las matemáticas y quieres que tu trabajo impacte en miles de alumnos y docentes, ¡este es tu lugar!

¿Qué puedes esperar de Innovamat?🤗

We aim high: Nos marcamos objetivos ambiciosos y trabajamos con determinación y pasión por transformar la educación. Aquí podrás crecer tanto como quieras, rodeado de personas que te impulsan, te inspiran y te ayudan a dar siempre tu mejor versión.

We are owners: Desde el primer día tendrás impacto real. No venimos solo a ejecutar, sino a pensar, decidir y construir. Confiamos en ti para tomar la iniciativa, proponer ideas y ver cómo se convierten en realidad.

We move fast: Trabajamos en un entorno dinámico donde la agilidad y la adaptabilidad marcan la diferencia. Sentirás el ritmo, la energía y la emoción de aprender rápido, actuar con criterio y hacer que las cosas pasen.

We are eager to learn: Somos curiosos, nos cuestionamos y compartimos lo que aprendemos. Cada reto es una oportunidad para mejorar y seguir creciendo, tanto a nivel individual como en equipo.

We are humble: Fomentamos una cultura de confianza y feedback donde todos tenemos voz. Escuchamos activamente, colaboramos y valoramos las ideas por su impacto. Aquí encontrarás un equipo siempre dispuesto a ayudar, compartir y celebrar los logros juntos.

We enjoy the ride: Nuestro impacto depende de las personas que lo hacen posible. Por eso cuidamos nuestra cultura con confianza, flexibilidad y bienestar. Ofrecemos horarios flexibles, descanso la semana Navidad y compensación flexible. Y, por supuesto, ¡nos encanta reconectar en los teambuildings que nos recuerdan por qué hacemos lo que hacemos!

¡Si todo esto resuena contigo, aplica!

Title: Data Analyst | E Commerce
Description:
🔹 Data Analyst | E- Commerce🔹




📌 About the role

We are looking for an Ecommerce Data Analyst to join an international digital and ecommerce environment.

In this role, you will play a key part in understanding customer behaviour across digital channels and transforming data into actionable insights that improve customer experience and commercial performance. You will work closely with business, product, UX, and technical teams, supporting decision-making across the ecommerce roadmap, experimentation initiatives, and customer journey optimisation efforts.

This is a highly cross-functional role, ideal for someone who enjoys working with large datasets, digital analytics tools, experimentation frameworks, and stakeholder management while helping shape data-driven decisions across multiple digital touchpoints.

If you enjoy working with SQL, Tableau, Looker, GA4, A/B testing, customer behaviour analytics, and ecommerce optimisation, this could be a great fit.




💻 What you'll do

🔹 Conduct analysis using internal datasets and digital analytics tools to generate actionable insights that improve customer experience and commercial performance.

🔹 Analyse customer interactions and performance across web, mobile, email, and kiosk touchpoints, identifying opportunities to improve engagement and conversion.

🔹 Build, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions using Tableau, Looker, and other visualisation tools, leveraging new and existing data sources.

🔹 Review and interpret digital performance metrics, including email marketing channel performance, to support continuous improvement initiatives.

🔹 Analyse on-site and in-app customer behaviour, identifying trends, opportunities, and friction points throughout the customer journey.

🔹 Collaborate closely with UX/UI Research, Product, Business, and Technical teams to understand user interaction patterns and inform prioritisation decisions.

🔹 Support experimentation initiatives by analysing A/B test design, execution, and results, helping drive experimentation and CRO decision-making.

🔹 Support key initiatives across the ecommerce roadmap, experimentation pipeline, and customer journey optimisation programmes.

🔹 Prepare reports and present insights to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

🔹 Translate complex analytical findings into clear, structured, and actionable recommendations.

🔹 Support ad hoc analytical requests and answer business questions with robust, data-driven insights.

🔹 Work with large datasets using SQL and analytical tools to uncover trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.

🔹 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve reporting capabilities, analytical processes, and data-driven decision-making.

🔹 Communicate complex analytical topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

🔹 Work in a fast-paced, customer-centric, and data-driven environment.




💡 Must Have

🔹 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business/Data Analytics, or a related field.

🔹 Minimum 2 years of experience in Digital Analytics, Ecommerce Analytics, Data Analytics, or similar quantitative roles.

🔹 Strong experience analysing large datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

🔹 Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, managing, and analysing large datasets.

🔹 Hands-on experience with dashboarding and data visualisation tools such as Tableau or Looker.

🔹 Experience analysing digital platforms, customer behaviour, and online performance metrics.

🔹 Experience with UX research methodologies and/or A/B testing frameworks in ecommerce or online sales environments.

🔹 Familiarity with ecommerce and behavioural analytics tools such as GA4 and Quantum Metric.

🔹 Proven ability to transform complex data into actionable business recommendations.

🔹 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

🔹 Ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

🔹 Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

🔹 Comfortable working in cross-functional and fast-paced environments.

🔹 English C1




✨ Nice to Have

🔹 Experience with scripting languages such as Python or R.

🔹 Experience working in ecommerce, digital products, or customer experience environments.

🔹 Knowledge of customer journey analytics and behavioural analytics methodologies.

🔹 Experience collaborating with UX/UI Research teams.

🔹 Experience reporting to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

🔹 Experience with experimentation platforms and optimisation initiatives.

🔹 Understanding of digital marketing metrics and email performance analytics.

🔹 Experience with additional BI and analytics tools.

🔹 Knowledge of customer segmentation, retention analysis, personalisation initiatives, or conversion optimisation programmes.




🏢 Hybrid model - 2 days on site per week







🌍 Why join this project?




🤝 People first – diverse and inclusive culture in an international environment.

📊 Work on high-impact Data & Insights initiatives across business performance, operations, finance, and commercial domains.

🚀 Help shape how data supports strategic decision-making across a large international organisation.

🧠 Explore the evolution of AI-driven analytics, productivity tools, and data discoverability.

⚙️ Contribute to self-service analytics, data products, and scalable reporting practices.

📈 Work closely with business and senior stakeholders, turning complex data into meaningful insights.

😁 High team stability and collaborative culture.

🎓 €1200 per year training budget and continuous learning opportunities.

💰 Flexible compensation model.

🩺 Private health insurance and benefits package.

⚡ Flexible working hours and hybrid model.

🏋️ Wellhub: fitness, wellness, and mental health support.

⚽ Football and paddle tennis teams sponsored by Capitole.

🥳 Team buildings, global events, and strong tech communities.

👉 Ready for the challenge? Apply now!




Empowering People, Unlocking Innovation.

Compliance with internal security and information protection policies is mandatory.

Description:
Buscamos Auxiliar Administrativo/a en Prácticas (100% Teletrabajo) 🌱

🚨 Aviso Importante

Queremos ser totalmente transparentes: este es un puesto de prácticas no remuneradas. Lo indicamos desde el principio para asegurar que los candidatos buscan específicamente este tipo de convenio formativo.

**¿Quiénes somos y a quién buscamos? 🌿**

Somos una empresa dedicada al paisajismo donde el trabajo en equipo es un pilar fundamental. Buscamos a un/a estudiante de Administración para dar soporte directo a nuestro administrador principal. Necesitamos a alguien con energía, gran compañerismo y una actitud proactiva para aportar nuevas ideas y sumar al equipo.

**¿Qué harás en tu día a día? 🪴**

Tu misión principal será dar apoyo al administrador, dividiendo tus tareas en dos grandes áreas:

Finanzas y Organización: Ayuda en la contabilidad básica, gestión de facturas, elaboración de presupuestos y organización general de la documentación.

Atención al Cliente: Serás el primer punto de contacto para nuestros clientes. Te encargarás de atenderles, resolver sus dudas, agendar horas para las visitas y dar seguimiento a las citas programadas.

**Requisitos que buscamos 🌳**

Imprescindibles

Estar cursando el Grado Medio de Administración (o una formación estrictamente relacionada) para poder formalizar el convenio de prácticas.

Dominio fluido de Catalán y Castellano.

Disponer de ordenador portátil propio y una conexión a Internet estable (el puesto es 100% telemático).

Ser una persona activa, con iniciativa y que demuestre una excelente capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Disponibilidad para incorporación inmediata.

Nuestras Condiciones (Flexibilidad)

100% Teletrabajo.

Horario flexible: No disponemos de un horario fijo. La persona en prácticas se adaptará a las horas del administrador, pactando siempre el horario entre ambas partes para poder compaginar las prácticas con otros estudios o empleos.

**Aspectos muy valorables (No obligatorios, pero suman): 🌻**

Tener interés por las plantas y el sector del paisajismo.

Conocimiento de otros idiomas.

Buen manejo de herramientas Office, Google Calendar y correo electrónico.

Conocimiento previo del software de contabilidad Holded.

Interés por la gestión de redes sociales.

**¿Cómo aplicar? ✉️**

Puedes aplicar desde la aplicación

El proceso de selección se realizará valorando el perfil más adecuado para el puesto. Las entrevistas y reuniones de selección se llevarán a cabo mediante videollamada.

Title: Product Data Analyst | EU based/Remote
Description:
Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success - powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 5 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your day-to-day:


Partner with Product teams to tackle challenges, reveal untapped potential, challenge status-quo and empower data-driven choices.
Use Amplitude to analyse user journeys and conduct A/B tests.
Use SQL and Tableau to extract and analyze data.
Build dashboards that make an impact - create powerful visualizations that give teams at Hostinger the visibility and confidence to take action, while ensuring data integrity and validity.
Use Lumos - our internal AI data agent to surface new insights and business recommendations.
Collaborate with our top-notch Data Platform team - work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to ensure data availability, efficient processes and successful project execution.


Real projects you might work on:


Analysing AI-Powered Marketing Tool Users - our AI-powered Reach Team needs to understand product usage, user segments and conversions. Your insights could help us refine our approach and shape the future of Hostinger's Reach product. If you want to go the extra mile - some product-related user flow analysis and A/B testing would be welcome too!
Decoding AI WebMail Clients Engagement - our Mail Team is rapidly evolving the communication experience, and they require deep analytical support to fuel their growth. You will dive into customer behavior patterns, providing the strategic clarity needed to shape the next generation of Hostinger’s email solutions through data-backed innovation.
