Title: Data Analytics & Insights Analyst
Description:
En Iberostar Group estamos buscando incorporar un/a Data Analytics & Insights Analyst a nuestro equipo de Dato en nuestra sede corporativa de Palma de Mallorca; pero antes de saber más sobre la posición, creemos que es importante que sepas un poco sobre Iberostar Group:




Somos una compañía 100% familiar con 70 años de experiencia en el sector del turismo. Hoy acogemos a millones de viajeros con la promesa de crear vacaciones felices y experiencias memorables, con una propuesta de valor fundamentada en la calidad y en la experiencia del cliente y del empleado.
Operamos en más de 100 establecimientos distribuidos en 35 destinos alrededor de 13 países de todo el mundo ubicados en localizaciones privilegiadas frente al mar.
Formamos parte de una familia de más de 35.000 personas de 95 nacionalidades, compartiendo los mismos valores: Responsabilidad, Transparencia, Humildad, Pasión y Creatividad.
Trabajamos para crear un lugar donde prosperar: cuidamos de las personas que forman parte de la familia Iberostar, impulsando su crecimiento, atendiendo a su bienestar y promoviendo la equidad como base de nuestras decisiones.
Nuestro movimiento Iberostar Wave of Change es nuestra hoja de ruta para impulsar nuestro propósito de liderar un modelo de turismo responsable.




Si esto te resulta interesante... ¡puede que éste sea tu sitio!




Misión




Dar sentido a los datos de múltiples fuentes, traduciéndolos en insights accionables y narrativas visuales (Dashboards) que empoderen a las distintas áreas de negocio para tomar decisiones informadas y basadas en la evidencia.




✔️¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones?




Diseño de Dashboards y Data Storytelling (Front-End BI): consumir los modelos de datos ya estructurados para diseñar, desarrollar y desplegar paneles visuales atractivos, intuitivos y de alto rendimiento en Microsoft Power BI (uso de DAX avanzado). Garantizar que la interfaz de usuario (UI/UX del dato) facilite una lectura rápida de los KPIs estratégicos.
Gestión y ejecución de proyectos analíticos: liderar el ciclo de vida de los proyectos de reporting asignados. Participar en la toma de requerimientos iniciales con los stakeholders y entrega final del producto conceptual, asegurando el cumplimiento de los plazos definidos en los sprints.
Gestión de demanda y consultoría funcional: actuar como consultor interno para las áreas de negocio. Analizar críticamente sus peticiones para unificar criterios, optimizar la demanda y mitigar la duplicidad innecesaria de informes dentro de la compañía.
Validación funcional y adopción del dato: asegurar que los desarrollos respondan fielmente a las lógicas de negocio solicitadas. Liderar la estrategia de capacitación a los Key Business Users para fomentar la cultura del autoconsumo de información.




🔎 ¿Quién es la persona ideal para este puesto?




Requisitos Esenciales:




Experiencia: entre 2 y 3 años liderando proyectos de Business Intelligence y desarrollando cuadros de mando en entornos corporativos.
Especialización: dominio experto en Microsoft Power BI, con fuerte foco en diseño visual, maquetación, buenas prácticas de visualización y fórmulas DAX.
Gestión de Proyectos: experiencia de trabajo bajo metodologías ágiles (Scrum/Kanban) organizadas por sprints (uso de herramientas como Asana o Azure DevOps).
Formación: Grado Universitario en ADE, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería IT o disciplinas afines.
Idiomas: Nivel de inglés medio (comprensión técnica).




Requisitos Valorables:




Arquitectura de Datos: entendimiento conceptual de entornos Cloud (Azure Cloud / Databricks) únicamente para comprender la procedencia y la trazabilidad de los datos que consumen los reportes y los agentes.
Interés o conocimientos básicos en lenguajes como Python o R enfocado a la exploración de datos.
Ecosistema GenAI y Agentes: familiaridad conceptual o experiencia práctica en la implementación de Agentes de IA y workflows basados en LLMs.
Herramientas AI Low-Code: conocimientos en plataformas de creación de asistentes y automatización con IA (como Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate AI features o similares).
Prompt Engineering: habilidad en la creación de instrucciones efectivas para optimizar el desarrollo propio (ej. generar DAX) y para guiar al usuario final en el uso de herramientas conversacionales de datos.

Title: Data Analyst II - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


2+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Experience working with Python is a plus
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass and access to Meditopia
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
Flexible workplace environment
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses


About Us

Ebury delivers sophisticated, integrated solutions — business accounts, hedging, and financing — on a single platform with a seamless workflow. Our success is built on a simple premise and singular purpose: To help businesses operate and scale globally.

Since its founding in 2009, Ebury has always been a fast-growing leader in fintech. Today, we bring together 2000+ Eburians across nearly 70 cities and we’re always looking to add to our team.

At the heart of our offering is a proprietary platform, purpose-built to help businesses seamlessly streamline and manage global cash flow. We focus on continuous product evolution and innovation to build the infrastructure for borderless growth and help our clients scale at every stage.

The opportunities at Ebury are as diverse as our people, ranging from business development to engineering roles across our tech pillars.

We believe in inclusion. We stand against discrimination in all forms and are against the intolerance of differences that makes us a modern and successful organisation. At Ebury, you can be whoever you want to be and still feel a sense of belonging no matter your story.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Junior/Mid)
Place: Las Palmas de Gran Canaria, Canary Islands, Spain
Description:
En Domingo Alonso Group buscamos incorporar un/a Business Intelligence Analyst. Buscamos a alguien apasionado por el análisis de datos y la estrategia, pero sobre todo, con un fuerte espíritu crítico. Queremos sumar al equipo a una persona analítica e inconformista, con la iniciativa necesaria para profundizar en el origen de cada situación y cuestionar los datos para aportar valor real.




En este rol, serás clave para el desarrollo y mantenimiento de soluciones de datos integrales, abarcando desde la creación de informes y cuadros de mando hasta la participación en iniciativas impulsadas por Inteligencia Artificial. Apoyándote en tus habilidades con SQL y trabajando directamente con Databricks y Power BI, trabajarás codo con codo tanto con las distintas unidades de negocio como con otros profesionales del área, traduciendo sus necesidades en insights claros y directamente accionables. Todo ello en un entorno tecnológico de vanguardia donde apostamos por infraestructuras punteras como Azure Cloud y Databricks.




¿Quién NOS ENCAJA en este puesto?




Una persona analítica con capacidad para interpretar datos, además de buena comunicación y orientación al cliente. También, a nivel técnico, es importante que tenga experiencia co herramientas de Reporting/Business Intelligence (como, por ejemplo, PowerBI), conocimiento de SQL y Python.




¿Cuáles serían tus RESPONSABILIDADES?




Interlocución con el negocio: Hablar con las diferentes unidades de la empresa para entender profundamente sus problemas y traducirlos en soluciones de datos efectivas.
Diseño de dashboards e informes: Crear y mantener cuadros de mando interactivos que simplifiquen el acceso a la información.
Automatización de reportes: Optimizar los flujos de información actuales para eliminar tareas manuales y garantizar reportes siempre actualizados.
Extracción y transformación de datos: Recopilar, limpiar y modelar datos para asegurar su calidad y consistencia.
Gobernanza del dato: Asegurar la precisión de la información y documentar los procesos para mantener una "única fuente de verdad" en la compañía.
Colaborar en la creación y mantenimiento de documentación técnica y funcional.




¿Qué te OFRECEMOS?




Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo.
Beneficios adicionales.
Trabajar en un entorno tecnológico e innovador donde poder aportar todas las ideas y mejoras que se te ocurran.
Posibilidad de desarrollo profesional.
Formación continua.
Jornada completa (40 hrs/semana).
Horario: 08:00 a 16:00h




Si te apasiona el mundo de los datos y estás buscando una oportunidad para crecer en un entorno desafiante, ¡esperamos tu aplicación!




REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS:




Título universitario o a punto de concluir en Ingeniería Informática, Ciencia de Datos o campo relacionado.
Conocimientos sólidos en SQL para la manipulación de datos.
Conocimientos sólidos en herramientas de visualización de datos como Power BI o similares.
Conocimientos de estadística y análisis de datos.
Comprensión básica de los principios de modelado de datos.
Habilidad para trabajar en equipo y comunicarse eficazmente.
Deseo de aprender y crecer en un entorno dinámico.
Aunque no son requisitos para el puesto, también valoramos:
Lenguajes de programación: Conocimientos básicos o intermedios de Python o R para análisis estadístico avanzado o automatización de tareas.
Entornos Cloud: Experiencia previa trabajando con plataformas en la nube como Databricks, AWS o Azure.
Certificaciones oficiales: Contar con certificaciones en herramientas clave (ej. PL-300 de Power BI)
Analítica predictiva: Nociones o interés en modelos de Machine Learning y estadística aplicada al negocio. Conocimientos en herramientas de CI/CD y repositorio de versiones.

Ejecutivo/a de Revenue




Descripción del empleo




¿Te interesaría participar en un plan de carrera internacional con nosotros?




Esta posición ayudarás al departamento de Revenue mediante la creación y análisis de documentos que ayuden a automatizar procesos y agilicen la toma de decisiones.




Principales funciones a realizar:




En colaboración con los equipos de Inventario y Pricing crear dashboards e informes automatizados de revenue en herramientas como Microstrategy y Excel.

En coordinación con otros departamentos implementar estrategias de precios dinámicos basadas en demanda, datos históricos y competencia.
Forecasting: Análisis de datos históricos y tendencias para proyectar ventas.
Análisis de resultados (recomendaciones acciones correctivas si aplican).

Manejo del excel nivel avanzado, con conocimientos de programación dentro de los documentos (se valorará manejo de otras herramientas como Phyton, Power Query y plataformas de IA).
Conectividad: Se valorará la capacidad de integrar y extraer datos directamente desde sistemas PMS, RMS o Channel Managers.

Inglés fluido (hablado y escrito).
Habilidades organizativas y atención al detalle tanto en la precisión del dato como en la estética visual de las entregas.

Gestión del tiempo y de proyectos.
Buenas habilidades numéricas y capacidad analítica.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo.

Programa de Excelencia: Incorporación al programa de desarrollo de talento internacional de RIU Hotels & Resorts.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Block Labs

Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming. We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products.

We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence.

We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong.

About The Role

We’re looking for a data-obsessed BI Analyst to turn blockchain and product data into crisp insights that drive growth, retention, and risk controls across our crypto-enabled iGaming products. You’ll own the end-to-end analytics stack for wallet funnels, wagering behavior, lifecycle marketing, and compliance—using SQL, DBT, Python, Amplitude and Tableau as your primary tools. In the future we planning transition from Tableau to other BI tools alternatives like Metabase or Apache Superset or others.

Key Responsibilities


Drive the business forward through proactive analytics - don't just fulfill dashboard requests; spot anomalies, frame the right question yourself, and bring actionable recommendations to Product / CRM / Risk before they have to ask..
Build, maintain, and iterate dashboards surfacing KPIs (GGR/NGR, ARPU, LTV, churn, deposit→wager conversion, fraud loss rate).
Write production-grade SQL (CTEs, window functions, incremental models) to model clean datasets from Clickhouse and on-chain tables.
Build and maintain AI-agent workflows that automate recurring analytics - anomaly investigation, root-cause loops etc.
Use Python (pandas, seaborn, sklearn, scipy) for analysis, data quality checks, lightweight ETL/backfills, API pulls (e.g., blockchain providers), and automation.
Work with on-chain data: parse EVM logs, token transfers (ERC-20/721), join labeled address datasets, analyze exchange/bridge flows, gas/fee dynamics, and wallet clustering.
Partner with Product, Marketing/CRM, Risk/Compliance, and Engineering to define event schemas and tracking plans; ensure data quality, lineage, and documentation.
Design and analyze experiments, cohort analyses, and attribution within iGaming and regional compliance constraints.
Investigate anomalies (bonus abuse, botting, arbitrage, suspicious wallet rings) and recommend mitigations.
Automate recurring reporting and alerting for KPI movements.


Must-haves


2+ years in BI or Data Analytics; crypto or iGaming exposure prefered.
Ambitions about building great analytics infrastructure.
Good SQL: complex joins, window functions, query optimization, and dimensional modeling.
Solid AI-collaboration craft — prompt & context engineering, spec-driven task framing, and eval-driven iteration. Comfortable decomposing business questions into precise, agent-executable steps and designing the right tools for the agent to call.
BI Versatility: Expert knowledge of Tableau (LODs, parameters, performance tuning) combined with a strong interest or experience in modern, open-source BI tools like Metabase or Apache Superset.
Proficient Python for analytics & data engineering: pandas, modular scripts/notebooks, API integrations, scheduling small jobs, and writing maintainable code.
Solid statistics and probability fundamentals for experimentation - hypothesis testing, sample size and power, confidence intervals, and the discipline to distinguish real signal from noise.
Practical understanding of crypto wallets and transaction flows.


Nice-to-haves


dbt, Great Expectations/Monte Carlo for data quality; orchestration with Airflow/Prefect.
Built or contributed to production AI agents for analytics — ReAct loops, RAG over a knowledge base , MCP servers for data sources, multi-agent orchestration. Knows how to curate domain knowledge for agents so they stop hallucinating.
Ability to produce on-chain analytics (Dune/Flipside/Goldsky/Nansen tables or self-indexed data; contract ABIs; entity labeling).
Warehouse ecosystems knowledge Clickhouse, AWS, S3 buckets.
Data governance & privacy (GDPR, data minimization, retention policies).
Understanding of iGaming economics & KPIs: deposits, wagers, hold, GGR/NGR, RTP, bonus efficiency, RG metrics, and common fraud/AML patterns.
Experience with product analytics services like Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics.


What kind of culture can I expect?

Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
¡En Neural buscamos un/a Analista de Datos! 🌟




¿Quiénes somos? 🏢




Nuestra misión es clara: mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la neurorrehabilitación, el acompañamiento en salud mental y la atención a la infancia con trastornos del neurodesarrollo.

¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

Para seguir creciendo, necesitamos incorporar a una persona que comparta nuestra visión, buscamos un Analista de Datos que transforme datos operativos y de negocio en información accionable. Trabajará junto a equipos de tecnología y negocio para diseñar métricas, construir cuadros de mando y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? 📝




Recopilar, depurar y modelar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes y plataformas.
Diseñar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes (Power BI / equivalente) para las unidades de negocio.
Analizar tendencias, incidencias y patrones de uso para anticipar problemas de forma proactiva.
Definir y calcular KPIs de servicio (SLA, capacidad, utilización) y de negocio.
Automatizar consultas y procesos repetitivos de reporting mediante SQL y scripting.
Documentar especificaciones de datos y garantizar la calidad e integridad de la información.
Colaborar con Business Analysts, arquitectos y equipos de proyecto para alinear objetivos y entregables.




¿Qué ofrecemos? 📃

Contrato indefinido
Jornada laboral completa y flexible, distribuida de lunes a viernes
Jornada intensiva en julio y agosto
Plan de carrera, formación y desarrollo profesional
Salario a convenir

¿Dónde?📍

Nuestras oficinas centrales se encuentran en Valencia (Polígono Vara de Quart).

¿Te apetece formar parte de nuestro equipo? 🚀

¿Te interesa participar en este proyecto? Si es así y cumples con los requisitos indicados, no dudes en inscribirte a esta oferta de empleo.

Requisitos mínimos




Grado profesional/universitario con 4-6 años de experiencia en analítica de datos o roles equivalentes.
Dominio de SQL y de al menos una herramienta de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similar).
Experiencia en modelado de datos, ETL y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de información.
Conocimiento de estadística descriptiva y capacidad de análisis de tendencias.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para traducir datos en recomendaciones de negocio.

Competencias deseables:

Python o R para análisis avanzado y automatización.
Experiencia con plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP) y servicios de datos gestionados.
Conocimiento de gobierno del dato y buenas prácticas de seguridad de la información.

Founded in 2006 with the mission "To Challenge Complexity", Closer Consulting is a Data Science company specializing in Business Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence.

Developing projects in the most diverse industries – Banking, Telecommunications, Healthcare, Retail, Energy, Insurance, and Aviation, among others –, we have created an environment where the brightest enquiring minds feel at home, providing our people with the means, opportunities and support they need to thrive and innovate.


We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to take on new challenges in a hybrid work model in Porto.


Are you the one?


What You'll Do

  • Process Automation: Analyse, re-engineer, and automate complex risk management processes using Python, adhering to production-level coding standards.
  • Tool & App Development: Build interactive visualization tools, bots, and APIs to streamline risk decision-making and operational efficiency.
  • Cross-Margining Deliverables: Collaborate closely with risk managers to develop specialized tools for cross-margining and dynamic risk monitoring.
  • Production-Ready Coding: Work hand-in-hand with RISK IT to write clean, maintainable code directly within official production environments.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate complex user requirements from risk analysts into practical, high-impact digital solutions.

Required Skills

  • Education: Master’s degree in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: 2 to 5 years of professional experience in financial markets, risk management, or quantitative data analysis.
  • Financial Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of risk management concepts and familiarity with cross-margining.
  • Python Mastery: Solid working knowledge of Python focused on data analysis, with hands-on experience in Pandas, NumPy, and building APIs.
  • Engineering Best Practices: Familiarity with full-stack concepts (e.g. HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and modern software development practices.
  • Data & Analytics: Exceptional ability to process, simplify, and extract insights from large, structured datasets.
  • Communication: Expert level in English, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders and technical teams.


If you believe in this match as much as we do, send us your CV to lia.giannone@closer.pt and reach the closer side of life.


Closer is a company that values diversity and inclusion. We are committed to fostering an environment where everyone is treated with dignity and respect, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, or other personal characteristics.


At Closer, we embrace the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings, and we believe that it is a fundamental driver for the success we've achieved.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
We are growing. And we are looking for talented people.




At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent.

We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives.




As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams.




We are looking for an Data Analyst!




Responsabilities:

Collect, process, and analyze large datasets to support the Global Markets Front Office.
Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL processes and automated data pipelines.
Build, optimize, and maintain data warehouses and data models to support business reporting and analytics.
Develop dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide actionable business insights.
Automate data processing and reporting workflows using Python and SQL.
Collaborate with business sponsors, Sales, Traders, and technical teams to understand data requirements and deliver analytical solutions.
Perform data validation, quality assurance, and reconciliation to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Translate business requirements into technical data solutions and analytical models.
Support the industrialization and optimization of data processing activities.
Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and operational processes.
Document data flows, ETL processes, and analytical solutions following best practices.




Requirements:

Technical Skills

Experience in Data Analysis, Business Intelligence, or Data Engineering roles.
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for data processing, automation, and analysis.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL processes and data pipelines.
Solid knowledge of Data Warehousing concepts, data modeling, and relational databases.
Experience building reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using BI tools.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
Experience working with large and complex datasets.
Knowledge of data quality, data validation, and reporting best practices.
Ability to gather business requirements and translate them into technical data solutions.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with business users and technical teams.
Good level of english.




Nice to Have

Experience within Global Markets, Capital Markets, Investment Banking, or Financial Services.
Knowledge of Front Office business processes and financial products.
Experience with data automation and process industrialization initiatives.
Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience working in Agile environments.




Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously.




Find with us the right opportunity to grow!




What you can expect from us:

Long-term projects with national and international context (if applicable)
Opportunities to grow technically and professionally
A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust
Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability.




If you’re interested in this job, please send your CV to cesaltina.abreu@decskill.com with reference “CA/DataAnalyst".




Thank You! 😊

Description:

Are you passionate about Python, Data Analytics, and Financial Risk? We're looking for a Python Developer to join an international team focused on building innovative digital solutions that transform risk management processes.

Working alongside risk specialists and technology teams, you'll develop automation tools, interactive dashboards, and data-driven applications that improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and support better business decision-making.




What you'll do

Design and develop Python-based solutions to automate risk management processes.
Analyse and re-engineer existing workflows to improve efficiency and user experience.
Build data processing tools and analytics solutions using modern Python libraries.
Collaborate closely with risk analysts to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Develop dashboards, APIs, and automation tools following Agile and software engineering best practices.
Work with large datasets to generate meaningful insights and support decision-making.
Contribute to the continuous evolution of digital solutions used by international teams.




What we're looking for

Master's degree in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
2–5 years of experience in Financial Services, Risk Management, Data Analytics, or a similar environment.
Strong programming skills in Python.
Solid experience with:
Pandas
NumPy
Data analysis and data manipulation
Experience analysing large datasets and transforming business requirements into technical solutions.
Knowledge of Market Risk, Counterparty Risk, or Cross-Margining is highly valued.
Experience working in Agile environments is a plus.




Nice to have

Experience developing dashboards, APIs, or automation tools.
Familiarity with HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
Interest in AI, process automation, or data-driven applications.




Soft skills

✔ Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

✔ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

✔ Collaborative mindset and team spirit

✔ Curious, proactive, and eager to learn

✔ Strong organisational and prioritisation skills

✔ Client-focused with attention to detail and quality




Language

Fluent English (mandatory)




Why join?

Work on innovative projects combining Python, Data Analytics, Automation, and Financial Risk.
Collaborate with international teams in a highly technical and business-focused environment.
Gain exposure to modern technologies, Agile practices, and AI-driven initiatives.
Make a real impact by developing tools that support critical risk management decisions.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Want to know how a leading workplace experience and facility management company is powered by technology?

At ISS Tech Team, we create smarter workplace experiences through technology. Our Global Technology Solutions team builds digital solutions, from sensors and IoT devices to data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities, that support our ISS A/S operations across Cleaning, Workplace, Food and Technical Services.

With tech hubs in Copenhagen, Warsaw, and Porto, and teams collaborating across more than 30 countries, our ISS Tech team develops our digital solutions that have a real impact on both our customers and our people.




Location: Porto, Portugal

Work regime: Hybrid







What will you do as Data Analyst:

Provide day‑to‑day operational support for quarterly carbon data collection and input validation.
Maintain strong data‑quality control at the input and pre‑processing stage to ensure smooth downstream reporting by the country decarb managers.
Support the implementation of standardised validation checks, anomaly detection, and country follow‑ups.
Assist in preparing clean, validated datasets for further analysis and reporting.
Contribute to audit‑readiness by organising documentation and evidence.




Key qualifications:

Must have:

Master’s Degree in Data or Environmental Science
More than 3 years’ experience in data handling, environmental data, or similar analytical support roles.
Strong skills in Excel, Power BI (basic visuals, data prep), and SQL (simple queries, data extraction).
Experience with data cleaning, validation, and structured data workflows.
English proficiency, both written and spoken.




Nice have:

Familiarity with emissions data or GHG concepts is an advantage but not required.
Comfortable in repetitive, detail-oriented validation work.




Personal skills:

Strong attention to detail and careful execution.
Strong communication and reliability under time pressure.




What ISS Offers You:

We focus on creating an environment where you can grow and perform at your best:

Permanent contract.
Private health insurance.
22 days of annual leave + 3 additional company days to recharge.
Flexible working hours and a hybrid model that supports balance and collaboration.
Continuous learning opportunities (technical and behavioural development) to support your growth.
Modern, well-equipped office in the heart of Porto.
Free parking for your convenience.
Access to ISS Tech Communities to connect, learn and share knowledge.
Free access to the company gym to support your wellbeing.
Snacks and drinks available at the office.




Why ISS

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.




ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.




ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

Title: Data Engineer
Description:
🚀 Procuramos um(a) Data Analyst / Data Engineer para integrar uma equipa onde vais fazer a ponte entre negócio, análise de dados e engenharia de dados.




Este papel é ideal para alguém que se sente confortável a falar com stakeholders de negócio, mas também gosta de trabalhar diretamente em pipelines, modelação de dados e soluções técnicas com impacto real.




🧑 💻 Como será o teu dia a dia:

Colaborar com stakeholders para recolher requisitos e traduzi-los em modelos de dados e especificações técnicas
Desenhar, estruturar e manter modelos de dados robustos, como star schemas e snowflake schemas
Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios de alto desempenho para apoiar a decisão de negócio
Garantir data governance, qualidade de dados, consistência e documentação clara
Desenhar, construir, testar e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT
Trabalhar com ferramentas de ETL, com foco em Stambia, podendo haver adaptação a outras ferramentas do mercado
Implementar automações de qualidade de dados e validações de integridade
Participar ativamente na evolução das soluções de reporting e integração de dados




🧠 O que procuramos:

Formação académica em área relevante, como Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Finance ou similar
Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em funções como Data Analyst, Analytics Engineer ou BI Developer
Forte componente analítica e experiência prática em desenvolvimento ETL
Excelentes conhecimentos de SQL, incluindo queries complexas, joins, otimização e stored procedures
Bons conhecimentos de modelação de dados e conceitos de data warehouse, com metodologia Kimball
Experiência com ferramentas de ETL, sendo Stambia uma mais-valia forte
Fluência em francês a nível profissional mínimo B2
Fluência em inglês, escrito e falado




⭐ Valorizamos ainda:

Experiência com Power BI, incluindo DAX e Power Query / M
Experiência em banca, seguros ou setor financeiro
Conhecimentos de Azure, AWS ou GCP
Noções de Python ou scripting em Unix/Linux
Capacidade para trabalhar entre equipas técnicas e áreas de negócio




💡 O que oferecemos:

Projeto desafiante com forte componente analítica e técnica
Oportunidade de atuar entre business e data engineering
Ambiente colaborativo e orientado à entrega
Possibilidade de trabalhar com ferramentas e contextos internacionais
Full visa support, se necessário




📍 Localização: Porto, Portugal

⚠️ Modelo: Híbrido




Pacote Salarial Junior: 12.880€ a 21.000€ brutos (14 meses) + Subsídio de Alimentação + Benefícios Flexíveis

Pacote Salarial Mid: 14.000€ a 28.000€ brutos (14 meses) + Subsídio de Alimentação + Benefícios Flexíveis

Pacote Salarial Senior: 20.000€ a 49.000€ brutos (14 meses) + Subsídio de Alimentação + Benefícios Flexíveis

Title: Data Quality Analyst (AI Model Data Analyst)
Description:
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Location: Portugal (1-2 days in office per week)

Travel: Occasional international travel may be required.

Salary: €16,000–€20,000 per annum

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick-and-mortar retail using deep-learning computer vision. Focal has been deployed at scale with the top retailers in the world. We are looking for smart, creative, and passionate people who love to learn, enjoy thinking critically, share our values, and want to build a great and enduring company.

We have built the next-generation operating system for brick & mortar retail. This OS leverages shelf-mounted cameras that constantly measure the state of the retailers’ shelves and use that information to order quicker and smarter, planogram better, and schedule, direct, train, and manage their staff. We have proven this with major retailers around the world.

Job Description

The quality of our computer-vision models depends entirely on the quality of the data they learn from. We are seeking a dedicated Data Quality Analyst to clean, review, and curate the training data that powers our systems. In this role you will assume accountability for the accuracy and consistency of our datasets, directly improving how well our models detect products. Meticulous attention to detail, strong data-handling skills, and the ability to meet quality and speed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are essential.

What You Will Be Doing


Review, clean, and correct labelled image and product data used to train our computer-vision models.
Identify and fix mislabelled, inconsistent, or low-quality data, and flag systematic errors in the labelling pipeline.
Conduct routine quality-assurance checks to catch data issues before they reach model training.
Onboard and scan products into the system, ensuring catalogue and reference data are accurate and complete.
Compare model predictions against ground truth to surface edge cases and areas where the model underperforms.
Work collaboratively with the machine-learning and operations teams to improve labelling guidelines and data standards.
Meet or exceed speed and quality Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) consistently.
Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members, providing updates on progress and raising any issues or challenges encountered.


Requirements:


Strong attention to detail and a genuine care for data accuracy and consistency.
Comfort working with large volumes of data, spreadsheets, and data-review or annotation tools
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to spot patterns and root-cause data errors.
An interest in or exposure to machine learning, computer vision, or AI data pipelines is advantageous but not essential.
Time Management: ability to work well under pressure, meet deadlines, and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
Communication Skills: effective communication to liaise with supervisors, team members, and the ML team, providing updates and raising issues.
Ability to work independently and stay focused on repetitive, detail-heavy tasks for extended periods.


Why Focal Systems


Strong Values and Mission — We are a tightly-knit team with an ambitious mission and a strong set of core values, which define our approach to business and have successfully guided us since inception.
Exceptional Team — We are a team of hard-working, fun-loving professionals from some of the most eminent universities, research labs, and tech companies of our time. We pride ourselves on recruiting exceptional individuals to help us redefine the state-of-the-art.
Outstanding Partners — We work with 10+ of the largest retailers in the world and have a world-class roster of investors, advisors and partners to support & advise us in our endeavors.


What we offer

We care deeply about the health, happiness, and wellbeing of all of our employees. We offer:


Paid Time Off
Pension
Sick Leave

Title: Data Science Associate (Fashion)
Description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Science Associate to join our Data and Analytics team in our Digital Campus in Porto.

Who We Are

The next step of your career starts here, where you can bring your own unique mix of skills and perspectives to a fast-growing team.

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering AI & Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

What We Offer


Opportunity to accelerate the pace of digitalization through advanced technology, business intelligence, and analytics.
Driving high-impact insights enhancing decision making across the entire organization.
Interaction with senior business leaders on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change.
Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team.



What You Will Do


Conduct advanced data analysis focused on Operations, Finance and Supply Chain (specific for our team).
Translate business problems into analytical solutions, from requirement gathering to model deployment and monitoring.
Build, deploy, and maintain machine learning models (e.g. Churn, CLV, Segmentation, Personalization) using modern MLOps frameworks (e.g. MLflow, Git).
Leverage Databricks, Azure, or similar cloud infrastructure for scalable data processing and model deployment.
Use Python, PySpark, and common ML libraries (e.g. scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, etc.) for data transformation, model development, and evaluation.
Apply statistical methods (e.g. hypothesis testing, A/B testing, confidence intervals) to validate performance and drive actionable insights.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly through compelling storytelling and visualizations.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Business teams, Data Engineering, IT teams) and contribute to customer-centric strategies.
Support team development through knowledge sharing, collaboration, and participation in agile working models.



What You Will Bring


3–5 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, ideally in retail or e-commerce.
A master's degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or Engineering.
Proven ability to manage the full lifecycle of an ML solution; business understanding, data wrangling, and modelling, to production deployment and monitoring.
Hands-on experience with MLflow, Git, and MLOps frameworks.
Solid programming skills in Python, including libraries like pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, matplotlib, seaborn, and PySpark.
Experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS, especially in the context of Databricks, data pipelines, and model hosting.
Good understanding of data warehousing and querying using SQL.
Familiarity with statistical concepts (e.g. experiment design, hypothesis testing, p-values).
Experience or strong interest in Generative AI applications, such as LLM-based solutions, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or AI-assisted analytics is a plus.
Exposure to Reinforcement Learning concepts is a plus, especially in areas like decision optimization, personalization, or next-best-action use cases.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to present technical insights to non-technical audiences.
Fluency in English (written and spoken).
Experience within the retail and fashion industry (nice to have).
Experience within international environments, consultancy, or a start-up environment (nice to have).



In a changing world, diversity and inclusion are core values for team well-being and performance. At Metyis, we want to welcome and retain all talents, regardless of gender, age, origin or sexual orientation, and irrespective of whether or not they are living with a disability, as each of them has their own experience and identity.

Title: Data Analyst Operations
Description:
Job Summary

The Data Analyst transforms complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organisation. Working as part of a matrix team and aligned to a specific functional area (Commercial; or Supply Chain, Procurement & Manufacturing), the role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand their priorities, interpret data in context, and deliver high quality analysis, dashboards, reporting, and presentations. The Data Analyst also supports the respective stakeholder function with projects, tools, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, drive productivity and strengthen data driven decision making, with involvement in and coordination of the optimization of functional processes, tools, and systems.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Functional Business Partnering and Insight Generation
You partner with the supported function to understand business priorities, interpret analytical results, and translate data into meaningful insights that unlock value-creation opportunities, and play an active role in the development and improvement of functional processes, tools, and systems.
You produce accurate, timely monthly management information for the area supported, including analysis, interpretation, and presentation of operational or financial results. In particular, you monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to the function supported and highlight emerging issues or deviations from plan.
You support functional performance cycles such as demand planning, SKU rationalisation or sales pipeline reviews depending on the analyst group.
You provide clear and actionable analysis on trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to the supported function to support operational and strategic decision-making.
You support the preparation of internal and external presentations(such as vendor or customer meetings), ensuring insights are communicated clearly and effectively.
You act as a trusted analytical advisor within a matrix structure, ensuring strong communication and alignment with both functional leaders and the Business Data Manager.
Data Cleaning, Preparation, Validation & Governance Alignment
You ensure that data pertinent to the function supported is clean and accurate for your function across various sources, such as JDE/ERP, SalesForce, New Horizon, Zycus, Ecovadis and other systems and tools.
You conduct cleaning, validation and preparation of data for operational use and analysis, ensuring accuracy and consistency in line with data governance standards and business guidelines.
You identify data quality issues and escalate them appropriately to the Business Data Manager and Data Architecture and Governance team.
You ensure all reporting uses approved definitions, metrics, and governed datasets.
Subject-Matter Expertise, Dashboards & Visualisation
You act as a subject matter expert in a designated field (e.g. SalesForce, OTIF reports, Zycus) supporting the effective use and evolution of these tools within the function.
You maintain PowerBI and other dashboards, reports, and visualisations that enable stakeholders to easily interpret key metrics and trends.
You run and distribute reports when required and not available in self-serve mode (e.g., performance reviews, monthly business updates, functional meetings), while promoting self‑service where appropriate.
You continuously improve tools and dashboard performance, usability, and clarity.
You suggest and participate in developing improvements to dashboards and reports.
Collaboration, Capability Build and Continuous Improvement
You provide super‑user type support and training to stakeholders on designed tools pertinent to the functional group supported (e.g. SalesForce, Zycus, Ecovadis), Power BI and data‑related activities.
You promote a data-driven culture across Elementis.
Consolidate feedback on new or updated reporting requirements and support the development of these tools and new Power BI dashboards or enhancements.
Collaborate with the Business Data Manager, Technical Specialist, and Data Governance teams to improve data foundations, reporting processes, and analytical capabilities.
Participate in periodic rotation across these expertise areas to broaden capability and organisational resilience.
Functional Projects, Initiatives & Processes
You support functional projects and initiatives by providing analytical input, co-ordination capabilities, and subject-matter expertise that enable better decision‑making, higher growth or more efficient operations.
You coordinate with cross‑functional teams to ensure functional project deliverables are aligned, well‑structured, and supported by accurate data.
You contribute to,and coordinate, improvements and standardisation of functional processes and procedures, automation opportunities, and enhancements to functional performance tools in line with best practice and IT guidelines.
When agreed with the function, you act as the custodian for functional policies and procedures and ensure these updated and stored in relevant repository (e.g. SharePoint, other tools)
You support internal and external audits, and any remediation actions arising from them.


Decision making

You validate business requests relating to data changes before instructing DIG to implement changes ensuring that both functional guidelines and data governance and quality guidelines are met.

You decide how to structure analysis and visualisations to meet business needs.

You make decision on projects, including timelines and milestones.

You resolve day‑to‑day analytical issues to ensure insights are accurate, timely, and aligned with functional expectations.

What will it take

Job Competencies & key personal attributes


Business Partnering & Communication: You work effectively in a matrix, engaging stakeholders across functions and presenting insights and complex concepts in a clear, compelling way. You support your stakeholders making the right decisions.
A dedicated self-starter with high enthusiasm - you need to be self-directed, self-motivated; ability to deal with imperfect information, decision and drive to successful conclusions is paramount in this role.
Drives engagement and influences effectively - it is critical that you are a strong relationship builder and can create a climate where you are able to influence stakeholders over which you have no direct lines of authority.
Analytical Problem‑Solving and “can do” attitude: You interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. You need strong problem-solving and issue resolution aptitude to address the daily situations that an analyst comes across.
Attention to Detail: You ensure accuracy in data updates, data preparation (e.g. pricing change requests), reporting, and other activity management, such as finance reconciliations and variance analysis.
Planning, Project Management & Prioritisation: You manage multiple requests, balancing BAU and ad‑hoc work, and deliver outputs on time.
Team player across functional and data team with uncompromising ethics and unwavering integrity - you need to be a humble, low ego individual who is strong team player, motivated by company goals rather than individual drivers, and with unquestionably integrity.


Technical Knowledge And Skills


Proficiency in Power BI and visualisation best practices.
Excellent Excel skills, including pivot tables, vlookup, advanced functions, graphs. Statistical knowledge is an advantage.
Proven track record of successful partnering with business leadership.
Advanced skills in data collections, cleansing and validation in order to minimize errors and discrepancies.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Knowledge of project management tools.
Familiarity with Python or other analytical tools is an advantage.


Position Requirements

Education:


Bachelor’s degree in an analytical or business-related subject (required).


Experience:


3+years work experience including experience in an international manufacturing/industrial environment.
3+ years work experience in an analytical or support role within a function: Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Manufacturing.
Demonstrated ability to deliver high‑quality dashboards, reports, and insights.
Experience working cross‑functionally and partnering with business stakeholders.
Experience of having managed projects.


Experience of operating under matrix management is a distinctive advantage.

IT Skills: Proficient Power BI (required), Proficient or expert level in MS Excel (required); Experience of using project management tools; Python, SQL, SharePoint management (is an advantage but not a must). Language Skills: Verbal and written fluency in English.

Working arrangements: The role is full-time and based at the Porto Hub (minimum 3 days per week in the office).

Traveling required: Occasional international travel to other Elementis sites as required.

Description:
About The Job


As a Data Analyst, you will join the RISK Commercial, Personal Banking and Services (CPBS) Analytics Platform, created in 2021 and part of the RISK CPBS Head Office teams. To support both RISK and the Business in monitoring the credit risk detection process, the Analytics Platform delivers services within the DERIK tool through a set of dynamic dashboards. These dashboards are mainly designed to facilitate the monitoring of alerts raised by detection tools, as well as the monitoring of portfolio quality. The most advanced technologies and methodologies available (Dataiku, Tableau) are leveraged to deliver high value‑added services while maintaining an excellent level of quality


Your Main Activities Are


Developments for data integration in the Data Transformation Mapping (DTM)
Building of the indicators of the DERIK CPBS tool, using the DATAIKU tool
Building of the dashboards for final users, using the TABLEAU tool
Technical documentation
Follow up of the processing chains
Force of proposal for functional enhancements, ergonomic improvements, and performance optimisations for the DERIK CPBS tool
Participation in the assessing of the quality of the data and the provided services
Conducting of dedicated analysis on specific topics and/or situations
Develop data integration processes in the DTM of the DERIK CPBS tool, based on the specifications, using the DATAIKU tool
Manage deliveries in production, after the testing phase validation
Perform the needed historical data loading
Write the technical documentation
Attend the expression of needs workshops (new needs, evolution of existing dashboards,...)
Based on the functional specifications, namely to develop the views for business indicator calculations in line with data visualisation needs, using the DATAIKU tool, and to build the dashboards for the final users, using the TABLEAU tool
Manage deliveries in production, after the testing phase validation
Ensure the functional testing phase of the dashboards before their release
Write the technical documentation of the views and of the dashboards
Ensure the follow up of the processing chains and the resolution of the incidents
Participate in the assessment of the quality of the data and the provided services
Conduct dedicated analysis on specific topics and/or situations
Be proactive in proposing functional enhancements, ergonomic improvements, and performance optimisations for the DERIK CPBS tool
Be able to propose and implement innovative methods and/or algorithms (for example, based on artificial intelligence)

Knowledge of data preparation and data visualisation
Knowledge and Awareness of Credit Risk
Awareness of IT security and cybersecurity
DATAIKU, TABLEAU, SQL
Organisational capacity
Rigour
Analytical capability
Ability to synthesise/simplify
Ability to communicate (oral/written)
Listening skills
Ability to collaborate/teamworking
Adaptability
Creativity and Innovation
Ability to solve issues
Ability to establish and create networks
Operational English – Read, written, spoken, French is a plus

Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Title: Marketing Analyst – Revenue Quality AI (Re‑Imagine RQM - 12‑month assignment)
Description:
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as a

Marketing Analyst – Revenue Quality AI (Re‑Imagine RQM)

Who We Are

FedEx is the largest express transportation company in the world, connecting more than 220 countries and territories. We work every moment to deliver the most important package of someone’s day. Our team of passionate people know their day-to-day work is invaluable in delivering outstanding experience to our customers. 530,000 team members strong, we are as diverse as the world we serve. We love what we do, and we do it well. Our reach is big, and so are our dreams. Join us and let's write our next chapter together.

What You Will Be Doing

Re Imagine RQM is our internal effort to build a full Revenue Quality Management (RQM) capability in Europe - developing practical, data-driven solutions that improve revenue quality and create the foundation for an AI-enabled RQM program over time.

As a Marketing Analyst in the Revenue Quality AI team, you will work hands-on with customer, shipment, and commercial data to identify opportunities, explain what is happening (and why), and turn insights into actions. You will help design and deliver early tools, reporting, and scalable analytical solutions that support decision-making and execution - aiming for multi million impact through improved revenue quality.

This is a great fit for motivated people across the business who enjoy solving problems with data, building practical solutions, and want to contribute to a high visibility initiative improving revenue quality using AI supported approaches.

Key activities


Develop data-driven insights: analyze large and diverse datasets to identify revenue quality opportunities, customer behavior patterns, compliance risks and drivers of leakage or inefficiency.
Translate insight into action: turn findings into clear, prioritized recommendations and help stakeholders understand “what to do next” and how to measure success.
Build practical solutions: contribute to creating and improving AI-supported tools, analytical products, automation, scorecards, alerts, and/or reporting that make RQM execution repeatable and scalable (solutions may evolve over time).
Connect data across sources: locate, extract, and connect relevant datasets; support data quality checks, documentation and consistent definitions to improve reliability and speed.
Collaborate cross-functionally: work closely with partners across Sales, Operations, Pricing, Finance/Analytics, and Engineering/Reporting support to align on needs, inputs and outcomes.
Support continuous improvement: help refine success metrics, validate assumptions, and improve how we monitor outcomes so insights lead to measurable impact.


What Do You Bring With You

We are looking for motivated analysts who enjoy working with data and building new capabilities.

Required Core Skills And Competencies


Hands-on AI expertise: proven experience applying artificial intelligence in real-world projects (e.g., machine learning models, generative AI, predictive analytics or automation use cases) with measurable business impact.
Agentic AI capabilities: ability to design, build, and deploy AI agents or AI-driven workflows to automate tasks, enhance decision-making, or orchestrate complex processes.
Statistical and machine learning fundamentals: solid understanding of core concepts (e.g., regression, classification, feature engineering, model validation, overfitting) and ability to apply them to real business problems
Data engineering & pipeline awareness: understanding of how data pipelines are built and maintained (ETL/ELT), including data modeling concepts and working with large-scale datasets in structured environments.
Model deployment & lifecycle management: experience contributing to or supporting the deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement of analytical models or AI-driven solutions in production environments.
Strong analytical problem-solving: able to structure ambiguous questions, analyze data and translate findings into clear insights and recommended actions.
Ability to work with big database understand the logic and aggregating them to support the required results
Tools
Data platforms or cloud-based analytics environments
Gemini or ChatGPT
Querying: SQL (able to pull/join/filter datasets and validate outputs)
Databricks or equivalent
Power BI
Data quality mindset: comfortable validating inputs, reconciling inconsistencies, documenting definitions and building repeatable logic.
Communication & storytelling: can explain the “so what,” highlight risks/opportunities and contribute to concise, decision-ready outputs for non-technical stakeholders.
Collaboration: able to work cross-functionally and adapt in a fast-moving build-and-learn environment.
Interest in AI-enabled approaches: strong curiosity and proactive mindset in applying AI/ML to detection, monitoring, prioritization and scalable execution.

Nice to have


Python for analysis/automation (or similar scripting experience).
Background in pricing, revenue management, finance, operations analytics, sales operations, customer or commercial insights.


What Do We Offer


Attractive compensation package
Training to get you started and on-the-job learning opportunities
Extensive learning resources to further develop your skills and knowledge
Tuition Assistance Program (*applicable for FedEx positions with a permanent contract)
Employee Assistance Program for you and your family in difficult life situations
Employee reduced-rate shipping
Great career opportunities
FedEx is one of the worlds most admired companies and trusted brands year after year

Title: Data Analyst Commercial
Description:
Job Summary

The Data Analyst transforms complex datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organisation. Working as part of a matrix team and aligned to a specific functional area (Commercial; or Supply Chain, Procurement & Manufacturing), the role partners closely with business stakeholders to understand their priorities, interpret data in context, and deliver high quality analysis, dashboards, reporting, and presentations. The Data Analyst also supports the respective stakeholder function with projects, tools, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance performance, drive productivity and strengthen data driven decision making, with involvement in and coordination of the optimization of functional processes, tools, and systems.

Responsibilities

Job Description


Functional Business Partnering and Insight Generation
You partner with the supported function to understand business priorities, interpret analytical results, and translate data into meaningful insights that unlock value-creation opportunities, and play an active role in the development and improvement of functional processes, tools, and systems.
You produce accurate, timely monthly management information for the area supported, including analysis, interpretation, and presentation of operational or financial results. In particular, you monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to the function supported and highlight emerging issues or deviations from plan.
You support functional performance cycles such as demand planning, SKU rationalisation or sales pipeline reviews depending on the analyst group.
You provide clear and actionable analysis on trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities relevant to the supported function to support operational and strategic decision-making.
You support the preparation of internal and external presentations(such as vendor or customer meetings), ensuring insights are communicated clearly and effectively.
You act as a trusted analytical advisor within a matrix structure, ensuring strong communication and alignment with both functional leaders and the Business Data Manager.
Data Cleaning, Preparation, Validation & Governance Alignment
You ensure that data pertinent to the function supported is clean and accurate for your function across various sources, such as JDE/ERP, SalesForce, New Horizon, Zycus, Ecovadis and other systems and tools.
You conduct cleaning, validation and preparation of data for operational use and analysis, ensuring accuracy and consistency in line with data governance standards and business guidelines.
You identify data quality issues and escalate them appropriately to the Business Data Manager and Data Architecture and Governance team.
You ensure all reporting uses approved definitions, metrics, and governed datasets.
Subject-Matter Expertise, Dashboards & Visualisation
You act as a subject matter expert in a designated field (e.g. SalesForce, OTIF reports, Zycus) supporting the effective use and evolution of these tools within the function.
You maintain PowerBI and other dashboards, reports, and visualisations that enable stakeholders to easily interpret key metrics and trends.
You run and distribute reports when required and not available in self-serve mode (e.g., performance reviews, monthly business updates, functional meetings), while promoting self‑service where appropriate.
You continuously improve tools and dashboard performance, usability, and clarity.
You suggest and participate in developing improvements to dashboards and reports.
Collaboration, Capability Build and Continuous Improvement
You provide super‑user type support and training to stakeholders on designed tools pertinent to the functional group supported (e.g. SalesForce, Zycus, Ecovadis), Power BI and data‑related activities.
You promote a data-driven culture across Elementis.
Consolidate feedback on new or updated reporting requirements and support the development of these tools and new Power BI dashboards or enhancements.
Collaborate with the Business Data Manager, Technical Specialist, and Data Governance teams to improve data foundations, reporting processes, and analytical capabilities.
Participate in periodic rotation across these expertise areas to broaden capability and organisational resilience.
Functional Projects, Initiatives & Processes
You support functional projects and initiatives by providing analytical input, co-ordination capabilities, and subject-matter expertise that enable better decision‑making, higher growth or more efficient operations.
You coordinate with cross‑functional teams to ensure functional project deliverables are aligned, well‑structured, and supported by accurate data.
You contribute to,and coordinate, improvements and standardisation of functional processes and procedures, automation opportunities, and enhancements to functional performance tools in line with best practice and IT guidelines.
When agreed with the function, you act as the custodian for functional policies and procedures and ensure these updated and stored in relevant repository (e.g. SharePoint, other tools)
You support internal and external audits, and any remediation actions arising from them.


Decision making

You validate business requests relating to data changes before instructing DIG to implement changes ensuring that both functional guidelines and data governance and quality guidelines are met.

You decide how to structure analysis and visualisations to meet business needs.

You make decision on projects, including timelines and milestones.

You resolve day‑to‑day analytical issues to ensure insights are accurate, timely, and aligned with functional expectations.

What will it take

Job Competencies & key personal attributes


Business Partnering & Communication: You work effectively in a matrix, engaging stakeholders across functions and presenting insights and complex concepts in a clear, compelling way. You support your stakeholders making the right decisions.
A dedicated self-starter with high enthusiasm - you need to be self-directed, self-motivated; ability to deal with imperfect information, decision and drive to successful conclusions is paramount in this role.
Drives engagement and influences effectively - it is critical that you are a strong relationship builder and can create a climate where you are able to influence stakeholders over which you have no direct lines of authority.
Analytical Problem‑Solving and “can do” attitude: You interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights. You need strong problem-solving and issue resolution aptitude to address the daily situations that an analyst comes across.
Attention to Detail: You ensure accuracy in data updates, data preparation (e.g. pricing change requests), reporting, and other activity management, such as finance reconciliations and variance analysis.
Planning, Project Management & Prioritisation: You manage multiple requests, balancing BAU and ad‑hoc work, and deliver outputs on time.
Team player across functional and data team with uncompromising ethics and unwavering integrity - you need to be a humble, low ego individual who is strong team player, motivated by company goals rather than individual drivers, and with unquestionably integrity.


Technical Knowledge And Skills


Proficiency in Power BI and visualisation best practices.
Excellent Excel skills, including pivot tables, vlookup, advanced functions, graphs. Statistical knowledge is an advantage.
Proven track record of successful partnering with business leadership.
Advanced skills in data collections, cleansing and validation in order to minimize errors and discrepancies.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Knowledge of project management tools.
Familiarity with Python or other analytical tools is an advantage.


Position Requirements

Education:


Bachelor’s degree in an analytical or business-related subject (required).


Experience:


3+years work experience including experience in an international manufacturing/industrial environment.
3+ years work experience in an analytical or support role within a function: Sales/Commercial, Supply Chain, Procurement, or Manufacturing.
Demonstrated ability to deliver high‑quality dashboards, reports, and insights.
Experience working cross‑functionally and partnering with business stakeholders.
Experience of having managed projects.


Experience of operating under matrix management is a distinctive advantage.

IT Skills: Proficient Power BI (required), Proficient or expert level in MS Excel (required); Experience of using project management tools; Python, SQL, SharePoint management (is an advantage but not a must). Language Skills: Verbal and written fluency in English.

Working arrangements: The role is full-time and based at the Porto Hub (minimum 3 days per week in the office).

Traveling required: Occasional international travel to other Elementis sites as required.

Title: Partner Operations Business Analyst
Description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace.

OPERATIONS

The Operations team serves as the backbone of our marketplace, seamlessly managing the entire order journey. From creating online content and ensuring secure payments to order fulfillment and delivery, while providing comprehensive customer and partner care, this team is relentlessly focused on improving the customer experience every single day.

PORTO

(Lionesa)

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

ROLE

We are looking for a highly analytical and technically proficient Partner Operations Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for transforming complex datasets into strategic, actionable insights. You will architect robust data models, build scalable BI solutions, and dive deep into operational data to identify bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Operations, and Analytics), and will leverage your expertise in SQL, dbt, and Looker to optimize partner processes, automate workflows, and provide recommendations that directly improve operational efficiency.

What You'll Do


Data Modeling & Transformation: Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable data models and transformation pipelines using dbt and SQL (BigQuery) to ensure clean, reliable data for the Partner Operations domain.
Advanced Dashboarding & Reporting: Own the end-to-end creation of dynamic reporting solutions in Looker. Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and build intuitive visualizations that provide clear insights into business trends, challenges, and opportunities.
Deep-Dive Data Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis on large, complex datasets to diagnose bottlenecks within Partner processes. Use structured, data-driven problem-solving to uncover root causes and identify growth opportunities.
Process Automation & Optimization: Identify areas for improvement in existing workflows and develop automated data solutions to reduce manual reporting and operational overhead.
Strategic Project Execution: Lead data-centric projects within Partner Operations from scoping to delivery, ensuring technical execution aligns with business objectives.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable initiatives. Engage with senior stakeholders to present insights, negotiate ROI-focused solutions, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.





Who You Are


A fast learner with exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, driven by data accuracy and process optimization.
Highly Technical: You possess advanced, hands-on experience with SQL/BigQuery and data visualization tools, specifically Looker (experience with LookML is highly preferred).
Data Modeling Expert: You have proven experience using dbt (Data Build Tool) to transform raw data into structured, analytics-ready models.
Strong Communicator: You excel at extracting insights from massive datasets and storytelling through data, with a proven track record of managing senior stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and intellectual curiosity.
Fluent in written and spoken English.





Bonus Points



Python Proficiency: Experience using Python for advanced data analysis, scripting, or automating operational processes.
Industry Experience: Previous experience working in Retail Operations, Online Marketplaces, or a similar high-volume operational environment.





Rewards & Benefits


Health insurance for the whole family and other well-being resources
25 Days of Annual Leave (above the statutory) and additional Caring Days (2 days per year) and
Boomerang: sabbatical program after 5 years service
Training opportunities and free access to LinkedIn Learning
Flexible benefits program
Flexible working environment

Ensure consistency and standardization across all reporting layers
Power BI Governance & Platform Ownership
Define and manage Power BI workspace architecture (dev/test/prod separation, naming standards)
Govern access control, roles, and permissions, ensuring data security and compliance
Establish content lifecycle management (certification, promotion, versioning)
Monitor usage, adoption, and performance across the platform
Drive governance policies to enable controlled self-service BI
Dashboard & Report Development
Design and build interactive dashboards and reports aligned with business needs
Translate complex data into clear, actionable visual insights
Apply data visualization best practices (UX, storytelling, usability)
Optimize report performance and usability
Work closely with stakeholders to iterate and improve reporting solutions
Collaboration & Leadership
Partner with data engineers to ensure high-quality upstream data
Support and mentor analysts and report developers
Act as a subject matter expert for Power BI across the organization

What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related field. Certification in Microsoft Power BI and Azure is a plus.
 3+ years of professional experience in Power BI / BI development.
Strong expertise in Power BI semantic modeling (Tabular models)
Advanced knowledge of DAX, SQL, and data modeling techniques
Proven experience with Power BI Service (workspaces, apps, permissions)
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI
Experience implementing PBI service governance and access control
Understanding of data lakes, data warehousing, and data modelling principles.
